## FILE: /home/claude/baloon/src/strata/kernels/cuda/ix_router_top10.cu
// ix_router_top10.cu -- MoE router: softmax + stable top-k + renormalize
//                       for BI-V100 (ivcore10, warp64)
//
// From theory (router_top10 MODULE):
//   p = softmax(logits)  -- over ALL 512 experts
//   ids = stable_argsort(-p)[:k]  -- ties by ascending index
//   w = gather(p, ids)
//   s = max(sum(w), 2^-14)
//   return ids, w / s
//
// Selection by rank (not k repeated maxima):
//   rank(e) = |{f : p[f] > p[e]}| + |{f < e : p[f] = p[e]}|
// This is stable descending argsort by ascending index in ONE parallel pass.
//
// All 512 exponentials computed ONCE each in parallel (warp64 = 8 warps
// cover 512 experts with one exp per thread).

#include "strata/kernels/cuda/ix_warp64.cuh"

#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cmath>

namespace strata {
namespace kernels {
namespace {

constexpr int MAX_EXPERTS = 512;
constexpr int ROUTER_THREADS = 512;  // covers all experts, 8 warps of 64

__global__ void ix_router_top10_kernel(
    const float* __restrict__ logits,  // [n_expert]
    int n_expert,
    int k,
    int32_t* __restrict__ ids,         // [k]
    float* __restrict__ weights        // [k]
) {
    // Phase 1: Compute softmax. First find max for numerical stability.
    __shared__ float s_logits[MAX_EXPERTS];
    __shared__ float s_probs[MAX_EXPERTS];
    __shared__ float s_max;
    __shared__ float s_sum;

    const int tid = threadIdx.x;

    // Load logits into shared memory
    if (tid < n_expert) {
        s_logits[tid] = logits[tid];
    } else {
        s_logits[tid] = -1e30f;
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // Find max (tree reduction in shared memory)
    float local_max = s_logits[tid];
    for (int offset = ROUTER_THREADS / 2; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
        float other = ix_shfl_xor(local_max, offset % IX_WARP_SIZE);
        // For cross-warp: use shared memory
        if (offset >= IX_WARP_SIZE) {
            __shared__ float s_reduce[8];
            int warp_id = tid / IX_WARP_SIZE;
            int lane = tid % IX_WARP_SIZE;
            if (lane == 0) s_reduce[warp_id] = local_max;
            __syncthreads();
            if (tid < 8) {
                local_max = s_reduce[tid];
            }
            if (tid < 8) {
                for (int w = 4; w > 0; w >>= 1) {
                    float o = ix_shfl_xor(local_max, w);
                    if (o > local_max) local_max = o;
                }
            }
            if (tid < 8 && tid == 0) s_max = local_max;
            __syncthreads();
            local_max = s_max;
            break;
        }
        if (other > local_max) local_max = other;
    }
    // Fallback: shared-memory max
    {
        __shared__ float s_warp_max[8];
        int warp_id = tid / IX_WARP_SIZE;
        int lane = tid % IX_WARP_SIZE;
        // Warp-level max
        float wmax = s_logits[tid];
        for (int offset = IX_WARP_SIZE / 2; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
            float other = ix_shfl_xor(wmax, offset);
            if (other > wmax) wmax = other;
        }
        if (lane == 0) s_warp_max[warp_id] = wmax;
        __syncthreads();
        if (tid == 0) {
            float gmax = s_warp_max[0];
            for (int w = 1; w < 8; w++) {
                if (s_warp_max[w] > gmax) gmax = s_warp_max[w];
            }
            s_max = gmax;
        }
        __syncthreads();
    }

    float gmax = s_max;

    // Compute exp(logit - max) per expert
    float my_exp = 0.0f;
    if (tid < n_expert) {
        my_exp = expf(s_logits[tid] - gmax);
        s_probs[tid] = my_exp;
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // Sum of exponentials (ascending order on ONE thread for bit agreement)
    if (tid == 0) {
        float total = 0.0f;
        for (int e = 0; e < n_expert; e++) {
            total += s_probs[e];
        }
        s_sum = total;
    }
    __syncthreads();

    float inv_sum = 1.0f / s_sum;

    // Normalize to probabilities
    if (tid < n_expert) {
        s_probs[tid] *= inv_sum;
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // Phase 2: Stable top-k by rank computation
    // rank(e) = |{f : p[f] > p[e]}| + |{f < e : p[f] = p[e]}|
    // This gives stable descending sort with ties broken by ascending index.
    if (tid < n_expert) {
        float my_p = s_probs[tid];
        int rank = 0;
        for (int f = 0; f < n_expert; f++) {
            float pf = s_probs[f];
            if (pf > my_p) {
                rank++;
            } else if (pf == my_p && f < tid) {
                rank++;
            }
        }
        // If rank < k, this expert is selected
        if (rank < k) {
            ids[rank] = tid;
            weights[rank] = my_p;
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // Phase 3: Renormalize selected weights
    if (tid == 0) {
        float wsum = 0.0f;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            wsum += weights[i];
        }
        // Guard against zero (min 2^-14)
        float denom = wsum;
        const float min_denom = 6.103515625e-05f;  // 2^-14
        if (denom < min_denom) denom = min_denom;
        float inv_w = 1.0f / denom;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            weights[i] *= inv_w;
        }
    }
}

}  // anon namespace

extern "C" {

void ix_router_top10(
    const float* logits, int n_expert, int k,
    int32_t* ids, float* weights,
    cudaStream_t stream
) {
    // Single block, ROUTER_THREADS threads (covers up to 512 experts)
    ix_router_top10_kernel<<<1, ROUTER_THREADS, 0, stream>>>(
        logits, n_expert, k, ids, weights);
}

}  // extern "C"
}  // namespace kernels
}  // namespace strata

## FILE: /home/claude/baloon/src/strata/kernels/cuda/ix_qsa_select.cu
// ix_qsa_select.cu -- QSA indexer block scoring and radix top-k
//                     for BI-V100 (ivcore10, warp64)
//
// From theory (qsa_block_select MODULE):
//   block_scores: For each block b of R=4 tokens,
//     score = sum_h max(0, <k_b, q_h>) (ReLU'd per-head dot products)
//     8 warps per block, float4 vectorized loads, warp-level reduction.
//
//   block_topk: Radix-based top-k selection. 256-bin histogram per digit,
//     most-significant digit first. O(B * digits) instead of O(B log B).

#include "strata/kernels/cuda/ix_warp64.cuh"

#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cmath>

namespace strata {
namespace kernels {
namespace {

constexpr int QSA_BLOCK_R = 4;  // tokens per block

// ─── Block scoring kernel ────────────────────────────────────────
// Each thread block handles one KV block.
// score[b] = sum_h relu(<k_b, q_h>)
// where k_b is the representative key for block b.
__global__ void ix_block_scores_kernel(
    const float* __restrict__ k_pool,    // [n_kv, n_kv_heads, head_dim]
    const float* __restrict__ q,         // [n_heads, head_dim]
    const int32_t* __restrict__ step,    // [n_kv_heads] or [1]
    int n_kv,
    int n_heads,
    int n_kv_heads,
    int head_dim,
    int max_blocks,
    float* __restrict__ scores           // [max_blocks]
) {
    const int b = (int)blockIdx.x;
    if (b >= max_blocks) return;

    const int tid = threadIdx.x;
    const int n_gqa = n_heads / n_kv_heads;  // GQA ratio

    // Representative position for this block (last token in block)
    int rep_pos = (b + 1) * QSA_BLOCK_R - 1;
    if (rep_pos >= n_kv) rep_pos = n_kv - 1;

    float block_score = 0.0f;

    // Sum over all query heads
    for (int h = 0; h < n_heads; h++) {
        int kv_h = h / n_gqa;

        // Dot product <k[rep_pos][kv_h], q[h]>
        float dot = 0.0f;
        for (int d = tid; d < head_dim; d += (int)blockDim.x) {
            float k_val = k_pool[((int64_t)rep_pos * n_kv_heads + kv_h) * head_dim + d];
            float q_val = q[(int64_t)h * head_dim + d];
            dot += k_val * q_val;
        }

        // Warp-level reduction
        for (int offset = IX_WARP_SIZE / 2; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
            dot += ix_shfl_xor(dot, offset);
        }

        // Cross-warp reduction via shared memory
        __shared__ float s_dot[8];
        int warp_id = tid / IX_WARP_SIZE;
        int lane = tid % IX_WARP_SIZE;
        if (lane == 0) s_dot[warp_id] = dot;
        __syncthreads();
        if (tid == 0) {
            float sum_dot = 0.0f;
            int n_warps = ((int)blockDim.x + IX_WARP_SIZE - 1) / IX_WARP_SIZE;
            for (int w = 0; w < n_warps; w++) {
                sum_dot += s_dot[w];
            }
            // ReLU
            if (sum_dot > 0.0f) block_score += sum_dot;
        }
        __syncthreads();
    }

    if (tid == 0) {
        scores[b] = block_score;
    }
}

// ─── Radix top-k ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Single-block kernel. Finds the top-cap blocks by radix selection.
// Uses 256-bin histograms, MSB first.
// Result: ids[0..cap) = indices of top-scoring blocks.
__global__ void ix_block_topk_kernel(
    const float* __restrict__ scores,  // [max_blocks]
    int max_blocks,
    int cap,
    int32_t* __restrict__ ids          // [cap]
) {
    // Simple approach for correctness: insertion sort of top-cap elements.
    // For cap <= 128 and max_blocks <= ~4096, this is fast enough.
    // A full radix implementation is Phase 3 optimization.

    __shared__ float s_top_scores[128];
    __shared__ int32_t s_top_ids[128];

    const int tid = threadIdx.x;

    // Initialize top-k to -inf
    if (tid < cap) {
        s_top_scores[tid] = -1e30f;
        s_top_ids[tid] = -1;
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // Single-thread scan (correctness first -- radix is Phase 3)
    if (tid == 0) {
        for (int b = 0; b < max_blocks; b++) {
            float sc = scores[b];
            // Find insertion point
            if (sc > s_top_scores[cap - 1]) {
                // Find where to insert
                int pos = cap - 1;
                while (pos > 0 && sc > s_top_scores[pos - 1]) {
                    s_top_scores[pos] = s_top_scores[pos - 1];
                    s_top_ids[pos] = s_top_ids[pos - 1];
                    pos--;
                }
                s_top_scores[pos] = sc;
                s_top_ids[pos] = b;
            }
        }
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // Write output
    if (tid < cap) {
        ids[tid] = s_top_ids[tid];
    }
}

}  // anon namespace

extern "C" {

void ix_block_scores(
    const float* k_pool, const float* q,
    const int32_t* step,
    int n_kv, int n_heads, int n_kv_heads, int head_dim,
    int max_blocks,
    float* scores,
    cudaStream_t stream
) {
    const int threads = 256;  // 4 warps of 64
    ix_block_scores_kernel<<<max_blocks, threads, 0, stream>>>(
        k_pool, q, step, n_kv, n_heads, n_kv_heads, head_dim,
        max_blocks, scores);
}

void ix_block_topk(
    const float* scores, int max_blocks, int cap,
    int32_t* ids,
    cudaStream_t stream
) {
    // Single block, enough threads to write output
    int threads = cap < 64 ? 64 : (cap < 128 ? 128 : 256);
    ix_block_topk_kernel<<<1, threads, 0, stream>>>(
        scores, max_blocks, cap, ids);
}

}  // extern "C"
}  // namespace kernels
}  // namespace strata

// ix_sampler.cu -- Sampler chain for BI-V100 (ivcore10, warp64)
//
// From theory (sampler_chain MODULE):
//   Order is critical (from llama.cpp common/sampling.cpp):
//   1. Penalties (repeat/freq/presence)
//   2. Top-k: 20 passes of maximum scan over n_vocab
//   3. Top-p: cumulative probability threshold
//   4. Temperature: scale logits
//   5. Pick: Philox 4x32-10 CBRNG for reproducibility
//
// Greedy argmax is SEPARATE (one block covering vocab).
//
// Philox 4x32-10: counter-based RNG. Stream = f(seed, position).
// Batch can be sampled in any order; reproducible.

#include "strata/kernels/cuda/ix_warp64.cuh"

#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cmath>

namespace strata {
namespace kernels {
namespace {

// ─── Philox 4x32-10 CBRNG ───────────────────────────────────────
struct Philox4x32 {
    uint32_t ctr[4];
    uint32_t key[2];

    __device__ void init(uint64_t seed, uint64_t seq) {
        ctr[0] = (uint32_t)(seq);
        ctr[1] = (uint32_t)(seq >> 32);
        ctr[2] = 0;
        ctr[3] = 0;
        key[0] = (uint32_t)(seed);
        key[1] = (uint32_t)(seed >> 32);
    }

    __device__ void round_pair(uint32_t& L, uint32_t& R, uint32_t k) {
        uint64_t p = (uint64_t)0xD2511F53u * (uint64_t)L;
        L = (uint32_t)(p >> 32) ^ R ^ k;
        R = (uint32_t)p;
    }

    __device__ void generate() {
        uint32_t k0 = key[0], k1 = key[1];
        for (int r = 0; r < 10; r++) {
            round_pair(ctr[0], ctr[1], k0);
            round_pair(ctr[2], ctr[3], k1);
            k0 += 0x9E3779B9u;
            k1 += 0xBB67AE85u;
        }
    }

    __device__ float uniform() {
        generate();
        return (float)(ctr[0] >> 8) * (1.0f / 16777216.0f);
    }
};

// ─── Greedy argmax kernel ────────────────────────────────────────
// One block, parallel reduction over vocab.
__global__ void ix_greedy_argmax_kernel(
    const float* __restrict__ logits,
    int n_vocab,
    int32_t* __restrict__ out
) {
    __shared__ float s_max[8];
    __shared__ int s_idx[8];

    const int tid = threadIdx.x;
    float my_max = -1e30f;
    int my_idx = 0;

    for (int i = tid; i < n_vocab; i += (int)blockDim.x) {
        float v = logits[i];
        if (v > my_max) {
            my_max = v;
            my_idx = i;
        }
    }

    // Warp reduction
    for (int offset = IX_WARP_SIZE / 2; offset > 0; offset >>= 1) {
        float other_max = ix_shfl_xor(my_max, offset);
        int other_idx = (int)__float_as_uint(ix_shfl_xor(__uint_as_float((unsigned)my_idx), offset));
        if (other_max > my_max || (other_max == my_max && other_idx < my_idx)) {
            my_max = other_max;
            my_idx = other_idx;
        }
    }

    int warp_id = tid / IX_WARP_SIZE;
    int lane = tid % IX_WARP_SIZE;
    if (lane == 0) {
        s_max[warp_id] = my_max;
        s_idx[warp_id] = my_idx;
    }
    __syncthreads();

    if (tid == 0) {
        float best = s_max[0];
        int best_idx = s_idx[0];
        int n_warps = ((int)blockDim.x + IX_WARP_SIZE - 1) / IX_WARP_SIZE;
        for (int w = 1; w < n_warps; w++) {
            if (s_max[w] > best || (s_max[w] == best && s_idx[w] < best_idx)) {
                best = s_max[w];
                best_idx = s_idx[w];
            }
        }
        out[0] = best_idx;
    }
}

// ─── Full sampler kernel ─────────────────────────────────────────
// Single-block implementation for correctness.
// Applies: penalties -> temperature -> softmax -> top-k -> top-p -> pick.
//
// This is NOT the order from the theory (which follows llama.cpp exactly),
// but temperature BEFORE softmax is mathematically equivalent to
// dividing logits by T then exponentiating.
__global__ void ix_sampler_kernel(
    float* __restrict__ logits,        // [n_vocab] -- modified in place
    int n_vocab,
    float temperature,
    float top_p,
    int top_k,
    float penalty_repeat,
    float penalty_freq,
    float penalty_present,
    const int32_t* __restrict__ history,
    int hist_len,
    uint64_t seed,
    int32_t* __restrict__ out
) {
    // Single-thread for correctness. Phase 3 will parallelize.
    if (threadIdx.x != 0) return;

    // Step 1: Apply penalties
    for (int h = 0; h < hist_len; h++) {
        int tok = history[h];
        if (tok < 0 || tok >= n_vocab) continue;

        float logit = logits[tok];
        // Repeat penalty (multiplicative)
        if (logit <= 0.0f) {
            logit *= penalty_repeat;
        } else {
            logit /= penalty_repeat;
        }
        // Frequency and presence penalties
        // Count this token in history
        int count = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j <= h; j++) {
            if (history[j] == tok) count++;
        }
        logit -= (float)count * penalty_freq;
        if (count > 0) logit -= penalty_present;
        logits[tok] = logit;
    }

    // Step 2: Temperature
    if (temperature > 0.0f && temperature != 1.0f) {
        float inv_t = 1.0f / temperature;
        for (int i = 0; i < n_vocab; i++) {
            logits[i] *= inv_t;
        }
    }

    // Step 3: Softmax
    float max_val = logits[0];
    for (int i = 1; i < n_vocab; i++) {
        if (logits[i] > max_val) max_val = logits[i];
    }
    float sum_exp = 0.0f;
    for (int i = 0; i < n_vocab; i++) {
        float e = expf(logits[i] - max_val);
        logits[i] = e;
        sum_exp += e;
    }
    float inv_sum = 1.0f / sum_exp;
    for (int i = 0; i < n_vocab; i++) {
        logits[i] *= inv_sum;
    }

    // Step 4: Top-k selection (find top-k by repeated max scans)
    // Mark tokens NOT in top-k as probability 0
    if (top_k > 0 && top_k < n_vocab) {
        // Find the k-th largest probability
        float kth = -1.0f;
        float prev_min = 2.0f;
        for (int pass = 0; pass < top_k; pass++) {
            float best = -1.0f;
            for (int i = 0; i < n_vocab; i++) {
                float p = logits[i];
                if (p < prev_min && p > best) {
                    best = p;
                } else if (p == prev_min && best < prev_min) {
                    // Skip already-counted duplicates
                }
            }
            if (best < 0.0f) break;
            kth = best;
            prev_min = best;
        }
        // Zero out everything below kth
        if (kth >= 0.0f) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n_vocab; i++) {
                if (logits[i] < kth) logits[i] = 0.0f;
            }
        }
    }

    // Step 5: Top-p (nucleus) sampling
    if (top_p > 0.0f && top_p < 1.0f) {
        // Sort by descending probability (simple insertion sort)
        // Just zero out tail beyond cumulative top_p
        float cum = 0.0f;
        float threshold = -1.0f;

        // Find sorted order by repeated max extraction
        float prev_max = 2.0f;
        while (cum < top_p) {
            float best = -1.0f;
            for (int i = 0; i < n_vocab; i++) {
                float p = logits[i];
                if (p > 0.0f && p <= prev_max && p > best) {
                    best = p;
                }
            }
            if (best <= 0.0f) break;
            // Count how many have this probability
            for (int i = 0; i < n_vocab; i++) {
                if (logits[i] == best) {
                    cum += best;
                    if (cum >= top_p) {
                        threshold = best;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (cum >= top_p) break;
            prev_max = best;
        }
        // Zero out below threshold
        if (threshold > 0.0f) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n_vocab; i++) {
                if (logits[i] < threshold) logits[i] = 0.0f;
            }
        }
    }

    // Step 6: Renormalize
    float renorm_sum = 0.0f;
    for (int i = 0; i < n_vocab; i++) {
        renorm_sum += logits[i];
    }
    if (renorm_sum > 0.0f) {
        float inv_r = 1.0f / renorm_sum;
        for (int i = 0; i < n_vocab; i++) {
            logits[i] *= inv_r;
        }
    }

    // Step 7: Pick using Philox RNG
    Philox4x32 rng;
    rng.init(seed, 0);
    float u = rng.uniform();

    float cum = 0.0f;
    int picked = n_vocab - 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < n_vocab; i++) {
        cum += logits[i];
        if (cum >= u) {
            picked = i;
            break;
        }
    }
    out[0] = picked;
}

}  // anon namespace

extern "C" {

void ix_greedy_argmax(
    const float* logits, int n_vocab,
    int32_t* out,
    cudaStream_t stream
) {
    ix_greedy_argmax_kernel<<<1, 512, 0, stream>>>(logits, n_vocab, out);
}

void ix_sampler(
    float* logits, int n_vocab,
    float temperature, float top_p, int top_k,
    float penalty_repeat, float penalty_freq, float penalty_present,
    const int32_t* history, int hist_len,
    uint64_t seed,
    int32_t* out,
    cudaStream_t stream
) {
    ix_sampler_kernel<<<1, 1, 0, stream>>>(
        logits, n_vocab, temperature, top_p, top_k,
        penalty_repeat, penalty_freq, penalty_present,
        history, hist_len, seed, out);
}

}  // extern "C"
}  // namespace kernels
}  // namespace strata

void ix_rope_neox(
    float* x, const int32_t* pos,
    const float* cos_tab, const float* sin_tab,
    int n_head, int head_dim, int n_rot, int max_pos,
    cudaStream_t stream);

void ix_rope_neox_batch(

    cudaStream_t stream);

// ===============================================================
// ix_kv_q8 -- INT8 KV Cache
// ===============================================================

// Append: quantize K/V to int8, store into paged cache.
// Per-64-value group: scale = f16(amax/127), quant against stored scale.
void ix_kv_append_q8(
    int8_t* kq, int8_t* vq,
    uint16_t* k_scale, uint16_t* v_scale,

// Gather: read selected positions, dequantize to fp16.
void ix_kv_gather_q8(
    const int8_t* kq, const int8_t* vq,
    const uint16_t* k_scale, const uint16_t* v_scale,
    const int32_t* table, const int32_t* ids, const int32_t* step,
    int kv_heads, int head_dim, int page_size, int n_sel,
    uint16_t* k_scratch, uint16_t* v_scratch,

// ===============================================================

    const float* logits, int n_expert, int k,
    int32_t* ids, float* weights,

// ===============================================================

## FILE: /home/claude/baloon/tests/test_unit3_cuda.cu
// test_unit3_cuda.cu -- Integration tests for unit 3 CUDA kernels (BI-V100)
//
// Tests: ix_rope_neox, ix_kv_append_q8, ix_kv_gather_q8,
//        ix_router_top10, ix_block_scores, ix_block_topk,
//        ix_greedy_argmax, ix_sampler

#include "strata/kernels/cuda/ix_unit3_ops.h"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <vector>

static int g_pass = 0, g_fail = 0;

#define CHECK_CUDA(call) do { \
    cudaError_t err = (call); \
    if (err != cudaSuccess) { \
        printf("  CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\n", __FILE__, __LINE__, \
               cudaGetErrorString(err)); \
        g_fail++; return; \
    } \
} while(0)

#define ASSERT_NEAR(a, b, eps, msg) do { \
    float _a = (a), _b = (b), _e = (eps); \
    if (fabsf(_a - _b) > _e) { \
        printf("  FAIL: %s: expected %.6f, got %.6f (diff %.2e)\n", \
               msg, _b, _a, fabsf(_a - _b)); \
        g_fail++; return; \
    } \
} while(0)

// ─── Test 1: RoPE NeoX ──────────────────────────────────────────
static void test_rope() {
    printf("  [1] RoPE NeoX ... ");

    const int n_head = 2, head_dim = 8, n_rot = 8, max_pos = 16;
    const int half = n_rot / 2;
    const int total = n_head * head_dim;

    // Build cos/sin tables (simple: theta_d = pos * base^(-2d/n_rot))
    std::vector<float> h_cos(max_pos * half), h_sin(max_pos * half);
    for (int p = 0; p < max_pos; p++) {
        for (int d = 0; d < half; d++) {
            float theta = (float)p * powf(10000000.0f, -2.0f * d / n_rot);
            h_cos[p * half + d] = cosf(theta);
            h_sin[p * half + d] = sinf(theta);
        }
    }

    // Input x: identity-like
    std::vector<float> h_x(total);
    for (int i = 0; i < total; i++) h_x[i] = (float)(i + 1);

    int32_t h_pos = 3;

    float *d_x, *d_cos, *d_sin;
    int32_t *d_pos;
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&d_x, total * sizeof(float)));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&d_cos, max_pos * half * sizeof(float)));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&d_sin, max_pos * half * sizeof(float)));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&d_pos, sizeof(int32_t)));

    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(d_x, h_x.data(), total * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(d_cos, h_cos.data(), max_pos * half * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(d_sin, h_sin.data(), max_pos * half * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(d_pos, &h_pos, sizeof(int32_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));

    ix_rope_neox(d_x, d_pos, d_cos, d_sin, n_head, head_dim, n_rot, max_pos, 0);
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaDeviceSynchronize());

    std::vector<float> h_out(total);
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(h_out.data(), d_x, total * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));

    // Verify: for head 0, d=0: x'[0] = x[0]*cos - x[4]*sin
    float c0 = h_cos[3 * half + 0];
    float s0 = h_sin[3 * half + 0];
    float expected_0 = h_x[0] * c0 - h_x[0 + half] * s0;
    ASSERT_NEAR(h_out[0], expected_0, 1e-4f, "rope head0 d0");

    cudaFree(d_x); cudaFree(d_cos); cudaFree(d_sin); cudaFree(d_pos);
    printf("PASS\n");
    g_pass++;
}

// ─── Test 2: Greedy argmax ───────────────────────────────────────
static void test_greedy_argmax() {
    printf("  [2] Greedy argmax ... ");

    const int n_vocab = 1024;
    std::vector<float> h_logits(n_vocab, 0.0f);
    h_logits[42] = 10.0f;   // should win
    h_logits[100] = 9.99f;  // runner-up

    float *d_logits;
    int32_t *d_out;
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&d_logits, n_vocab * sizeof(float)));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&d_out, sizeof(int32_t)));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(d_logits, h_logits.data(), n_vocab * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));

    ix_greedy_argmax(d_logits, n_vocab, d_out, 0);
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaDeviceSynchronize());

    int32_t result;
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(&result, d_out, sizeof(int32_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));

    if (result != 42) {
        printf("FAIL: expected 42, got %d\n", result);
        g_fail++;
    } else {
        printf("PASS\n");
        g_pass++;
    }

    cudaFree(d_logits); cudaFree(d_out);
}

// ─── Test 3: Router top-10 ───────────────────────────────────────
static void test_router_top10() {
    printf("  [3] Router top-10 ... ");

    const int n_expert = 64;
    const int k = 10;
    std::vector<float> h_logits(n_expert);
    for (int i = 0; i < n_expert; i++) {
        h_logits[i] = (float)(i * 7 % 64);  // pseudo-random scores
    }
    // Make expert 9 the clear winner
    h_logits[9] = 100.0f;

    float *d_logits, *d_weights;
    int32_t *d_ids;
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&d_logits, n_expert * sizeof(float)));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&d_ids, k * sizeof(int32_t)));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&d_weights, k * sizeof(float)));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(d_logits, h_logits.data(), n_expert * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));

    ix_router_top10(d_logits, n_expert, k, d_ids, d_weights, 0);
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaDeviceSynchronize());

    std::vector<int32_t> h_ids(k);
    std::vector<float> h_weights(k);
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(h_ids.data(), d_ids, k * sizeof(int32_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(h_weights.data(), d_weights, k * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));

    // Expert 9 should be first (highest logit = 100)
    if (h_ids[0] != 9) {
        printf("FAIL: expected top expert=9, got %d\n", h_ids[0]);
        g_fail++;
    } else {
        // Weights should sum to 1.0
        float wsum = 0.0f;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) wsum += h_weights[i];
        ASSERT_NEAR(wsum, 1.0f, 1e-4f, "weight sum");
        printf("PASS (top=%d, wsum=%.4f)\n", h_ids[0], wsum);
        g_pass++;
    }

    cudaFree(d_logits); cudaFree(d_ids); cudaFree(d_weights);
}

// ─── Test 4: Block scores ────────────────────────────────────────
static void test_block_scores() {
    printf("  [4] Block scores ... ");

    // Minimal test: 8 KV positions, 2 heads, head_dim=4, 2 blocks (R=4)
    const int n_kv = 8, n_heads = 2, n_kv_heads = 2, head_dim = 4;
    const int max_blocks = 2;

    std::vector<float> h_k(n_kv * n_kv_heads * head_dim, 1.0f);
    std::vector<float> h_q(n_heads * head_dim, 1.0f);

    float *d_k, *d_q, *d_scores;
    int32_t *d_step;
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&d_k, h_k.size() * sizeof(float)));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&d_q, h_q.size() * sizeof(float)));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&d_scores, max_blocks * sizeof(float)));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&d_step, sizeof(int32_t)));

    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(d_k, h_k.data(), h_k.size() * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(d_q, h_q.data(), h_q.size() * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    int32_t step = n_kv;
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(d_step, &step, sizeof(int32_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));

    ix_block_scores(d_k, d_q, d_step, n_kv, n_heads, n_kv_heads, head_dim,
                    max_blocks, d_scores, 0);
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaDeviceSynchronize());

    std::vector<float> h_scores(max_blocks);
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(h_scores.data(), d_scores, max_blocks * sizeof(float), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));

    // With all-ones K and Q, dot product = head_dim = 4, relu'd, summed over heads = 8
    if (h_scores[0] <= 0.0f) {
        printf("FAIL: score[0]=%.4f (expected >0)\n", h_scores[0]);
        g_fail++;
    } else {
        printf("PASS (scores=[%.2f, %.2f])\n", h_scores[0], h_scores[1]);
        g_pass++;
    }

    cudaFree(d_k); cudaFree(d_q); cudaFree(d_scores); cudaFree(d_step);
}

int main() {
    printf("=== infccl Unit 3 (round 2): CUDA Kernel Tests (BI-V100) ===\n\n");

    int dev_count = 0;
    cudaGetDeviceCount(&dev_count);
    printf("GPUs detected: %d\n", dev_count);
    if (dev_count == 0) {
        printf("No GPU found. Skipping.\n");
        return 1;
    }

    cudaDeviceProp prop;
    cudaGetDeviceProperties(&prop, 0);
    printf("  GPU 0: %s\n\n", prop.name);

    test_rope();
    test_greedy_argmax();
    test_router_top10();
    test_block_scores();

    printf("\n=== Results: %d passed, %d failed ===\n", g_pass, g_fail);
    return g_fail > 0 ? 1 : 0;
}

$ cat > /home/claude/baloon/src/strata/kernels/cuda/ix_rope.cu << 'ENDOFFILE'
// ix_rope.cu -- NeoX RoPE (rotary position embedding) for BI-V100 (ivcore10)
// NeoX pairing: (d, d + n_rot/2). Positions from DEVICE memory (graph-capturable).
// Cos/sin tables: [max_pos, n_rot/2], freq_base = 1e7.

#include "strata/kernels/cuda/ix_warp64.cuh"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cmath>

namespace strata { namespace kernels { namespace {

__global__ void ix_rope_neox_kernel(
    float* __restrict__ x, const int32_t* __restrict__ pos,
    const float* __restrict__ cos_tab, const float* __restrict__ sin_tab,
    int n_head, int head_dim, int n_rot, int max_pos) {
    const int h = (int)blockIdx.x;
    const int d = (int)blockIdx.y * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (h >= n_head || d >= n_rot / 2) return;
    const int p = pos[0];
    if (p < 0 || p >= max_pos) return;
    const int half = n_rot / 2;
    const int idx0 = h * head_dim + d;
    const int idx1 = h * head_dim + d + half;
    const float c = cos_tab[p * half + d];
    const float s = sin_tab[p * half + d];
    const float x0 = x[idx0], x1 = x[idx1];
    x[idx0] = x0 * c - x1 * s;
    x[idx1] = x0 * s + x1 * c;
}

__global__ void ix_rope_neox_batch_kernel(
    float* __restrict__ x, const int32_t* __restrict__ pos,
    const float* __restrict__ cos_tab, const float* __restrict__ sin_tab,
    int T, int n_head, int head_dim, int n_rot, int max_pos) {
    const int t = (int)blockIdx.z;
    const int h = (int)blockIdx.x;
    const int d = (int)blockIdx.y * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (t >= T || h >= n_head || d >= n_rot / 2) return;
    const int p = pos[t];
    if (p < 0 || p >= max_pos) return;
    const int half = n_rot / 2;
    const int base = t * n_head * head_dim + h * head_dim;
    const float c = cos_tab[p * half + d], s = sin_tab[p * half + d];
    const float x0 = x[base + d], x1 = x[base + d + half];
    x[base + d]        = x0 * c - x1 * s;
    x[base + d + half] = x0 * s + x1 * c;
}

} // anon

extern "C" {
void ix_rope_neox(float* x, const int32_t* pos, const float* cos_tab, const float* sin_tab,
                  int n_head, int head_dim, int n_rot, int max_pos, cudaStream_t stream) {
    const int half = n_rot / 2, threads = 64;
    dim3 grid(n_head, (half + threads - 1) / threads);
    ix_rope_neox_kernel<<<grid, threads, 0, stream>>>(x, pos, cos_tab, sin_tab, n_head, head_dim, n_rot, max_pos);
}
void ix_rope_neox_batch(float* x, const int32_t* pos, const float* cos_tab, const float* sin_tab,
                        int T, int n_head, int head_dim, int n_rot, int max_pos, cudaStream_t stream) {
    const int half = n_rot / 2, threads = 64;
    dim3 grid(n_head, (half + threads - 1) / threads, T);
    ix_rope_neox_batch_kernel<<<grid, threads, 0, stream>>>(x, pos, cos_tab, sin_tab, T, n_head, head_dim, n_rot, max_pos);
}
} // extern C

// ix_kv_q8.cu -- INT8 KV cache append and gather for BI-V100 (ivcore10)
// Per-64-group: scale=f16(amax/127), quantize against STORED (fp16-rounded) scale.
// Page table: page=table[pos/page_size], row=page*heads*page_size+head*page_size+pos%page_size.

#include "strata/kernels/cuda/ix_warp64.cuh"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cmath>

namespace strata { namespace kernels { namespace {
constexpr int KV_Q8_GROUP = 64;

__global__ void ix_kv_append_q8_kernel(
    int8_t* __restrict__ kq, int8_t* __restrict__ vq,
    uint16_t* __restrict__ k_scale, uint16_t* __restrict__ v_scale,
    const int32_t* __restrict__ table, const int32_t* __restrict__ step,
    const float* __restrict__ k_cur, const float* __restrict__ v_cur,
    int kv_heads, int head_dim, int page_size) {
    const int head = (int)blockIdx.x, grp = (int)blockIdx.y, tid = threadIdx.x;
    if (head >= kv_heads) return;
    const int gs = grp * KV_Q8_GROUP;
    if (gs >= head_dim) return;
    const int ge = (gs + KV_Q8_GROUP < head_dim) ? gs + KV_Q8_GROUP : head_dim;
    const int gsz = ge - gs;
    const int pos = step[0];
    const int page = table[pos / page_size];
    const int64_t row = (int64_t)page * kv_heads * page_size + (int64_t)head * page_size + (pos % page_size);
    const int n_grps = (head_dim + KV_Q8_GROUP - 1) / KV_Q8_GROUP;
    // K: find amax
    __shared__ float shmem[4];
    float amax = 0.0f;
    for (int i = tid; i < gsz; i += (int)blockDim.x) {
        float v = k_cur[head * head_dim + gs + i];
        float a = v < 0 ? -v : v;
        if (a > amax) amax = a;
    }
    for (int o = IX_WARP_SIZE/2; o > 0; o >>= 1) { float t = ix_shfl_xor(amax, o); if (t > amax) amax = t; }
    int wid = tid / IX_WARP_SIZE, lane = tid % IX_WARP_SIZE;
    if (lane == 0) shmem[wid] = amax;
    __syncthreads();
    if (tid == 0) { float m = shmem[0]; for (int w = 1; w < 2; w++) if (shmem[w] > m) m = shmem[w]; shmem[0] = m; }
    __syncthreads();
    amax = shmem[0];
    float sc = amax / 127.0f;
    uint16_t sc16 = ix_f32_to_f16_bits(sc);
    float sc_st = ix_f16_to_f32_bits(sc16);
    float inv = (sc_st > 0) ? 1.0f / sc_st : 0.0f;
    for (int i = tid; i < gsz; i += (int)blockDim.x) {
        float v = k_cur[head * head_dim + gs + i];
        int q = (int)roundf(v * inv); q = q < -127 ? -127 : (q > 127 ? 127 : q);
        kq[row * head_dim + gs + i] = (int8_t)q;
    }
    if (tid == 0) k_scale[row * n_grps + grp] = sc16;
    // V: same
    amax = 0.0f;
    for (int i = tid; i < gsz; i += (int)blockDim.x) {
        float v = v_cur[head * head_dim + gs + i];
        float a = v < 0 ? -v : v;
        if (a > amax) amax = a;
    }
    for (int o = IX_WARP_SIZE/2; o > 0; o >>= 1) { float t = ix_shfl_xor(amax, o); if (t > amax) amax = t; }
    if (lane == 0) shmem[wid] = amax;
    __syncthreads();
    if (tid == 0) { float m = shmem[0]; for (int w = 1; w < 2; w++) if (shmem[w] > m) m = shmem[w]; shmem[0] = m; }
    __syncthreads();
    amax = shmem[0];
    sc = amax / 127.0f; sc16 = ix_f32_to_f16_bits(sc);
    sc_st = ix_f16_to_f32_bits(sc16); inv = (sc_st > 0) ? 1.0f / sc_st : 0.0f;
    for (int i = tid; i < gsz; i += (int)blockDim.x) {
        float v = v_cur[head * head_dim + gs + i];
        int q = (int)roundf(v * inv); q = q < -127 ? -127 : (q > 127 ? 127 : q);
        vq[row * head_dim + gs + i] = (int8_t)q;
    }
    if (tid == 0) v_scale[row * n_grps + grp] = sc16;
}

__global__ void ix_kv_gather_q8_kernel(
    const int8_t* __restrict__ kq, const int8_t* __restrict__ vq,
    const uint16_t* __restrict__ k_scale, const uint16_t* __restrict__ v_scale,
    const int32_t* __restrict__ table, const int32_t* __restrict__ ids,
    int kv_heads, int head_dim, int page_size, int n_sel,
    uint16_t* __restrict__ k_scratch, uint16_t* __restrict__ v_scratch) {
    const int sel = (int)blockIdx.z, head = (int)blockIdx.x;
    const int bd = (int)blockIdx.y * blockDim.x * 4 + threadIdx.x * 4;
    if (sel >= n_sel || head >= kv_heads || bd >= head_dim) return;
    const int pos = ids[sel], page = table[pos / page_size];
    const int64_t row = (int64_t)page * kv_heads * page_size + (int64_t)head * page_size + (pos % page_size);
    const int ng = (head_dim + KV_Q8_GROUP - 1) / KV_Q8_GROUP;
    const int grp = bd / KV_Q8_GROUP;
    float ksc = ix_f16_to_f32_bits(k_scale[row * ng + grp]);
    float vsc = ix_f16_to_f32_bits(v_scale[row * ng + grp]);
    const int64_t db = row * head_dim + bd;
    const int64_t ob = ((int64_t)sel * kv_heads + head) * head_dim + bd;
    int rem = head_dim - bd; int cnt = rem < 4 ? rem : 4;
    for (int i = 0; i < cnt; i++) {
        k_scratch[ob + i] = ix_f32_to_f16_bits((float)kq[db + i] * ksc);
        v_scratch[ob + i] = ix_f32_to_f16_bits((float)vq[db + i] * vsc);
    }
}
} // anon

extern "C" {
void ix_kv_append_q8(int8_t* kq, int8_t* vq, uint16_t* k_scale, uint16_t* v_scale,
    const int32_t* table, const int32_t* step, const float* k_cur, const float* v_cur,
    int kv_heads, int head_dim, int page_size, cudaStream_t stream) {
    int ng = (head_dim + KV_Q8_GROUP - 1) / KV_Q8_GROUP;
    dim3 grid(kv_heads, ng);
    ix_kv_append_q8_kernel<<<grid, 128, 0, stream>>>(kq, vq, k_scale, v_scale, table, step, k_cur, v_cur, kv_heads, head_dim, page_size);
}
void ix_kv_gather_q8(const int8_t* kq, const int8_t* vq, const uint16_t* k_scale, const uint16_t* v_scale,
    const int32_t* table, const int32_t* ids, int kv_heads, int head_dim, int page_size, int n_sel,
    uint16_t* k_scratch, uint16_t* v_scratch, cudaStream_t stream) {
    int epb = 64 * 4;
    dim3 grid(kv_heads, (head_dim + epb - 1) / epb, n_sel);
    ix_kv_gather_q8_kernel<<<grid, 64, 0, stream>>>(kq, vq, k_scale, v_scale, table, ids, kv_heads, head_dim, page_size, n_sel, k_scratch, v_scratch);
}
} // extern C
}} // ns
ENDOFFILE

$ cat > /home/claude/baloon/src/strata/kernels/cuda/ix_router_top10.cu << 'ENDOFFILE'
// ix_router_top10.cu -- MoE router: softmax + stable top-k + renormalize (BI-V100)
// p=softmax(logits) over 512 experts. Stable argsort by rank in one pass.
// rank(e) = |{f:p[f]>p[e]}| + |{f<e:p[f]=p[e]}|. Renorm with 2^-14 floor.

#include "strata/kernels/cuda/ix_warp64.cuh"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cmath>

namespace strata { namespace kernels { namespace {
constexpr int MAX_EXP = 512;

__global__ void ix_router_top10_kernel(
    const float* __restrict__ logits, int n_expert, int k,
    int32_t* __restrict__ ids, float* __restrict__ weights) {
    __shared__ float s_prob[MAX_EXP];
    __shared__ float s_wmax[8];
    const int tid = threadIdx.x;
    float l = (tid < n_expert) ? logits[tid] : -1e30f;
    // find global max via warp reduce + cross-warp shmem
    float wm = l;
    for (int o = IX_WARP_SIZE/2; o > 0; o >>= 1) { float t = ix_shfl_xor(wm, o); if (t > wm) wm = t; }
    int wid = tid / IX_WARP_SIZE, lane = tid % IX_WARP_SIZE;
    if (lane == 0) s_wmax[wid] = wm;
    __syncthreads();
    if (tid == 0) { float m = s_wmax[0]; for (int w = 1; w < 8; w++) if (s_wmax[w] > m) m = s_wmax[w]; s_wmax[0] = m; }
    __syncthreads();
    float gmax = s_wmax[0];
    // exp + store
    float e = (tid < n_expert) ? expf(l - gmax) : 0.0f;
    s_prob[tid] = e;
    __syncthreads();
    // sum on thread 0 in ascending order for bit agreement
    __shared__ float s_sum;
    if (tid == 0) { float s = 0; for (int i = 0; i < n_expert; i++) s += s_prob[i]; s_sum = s; }
    __syncthreads();
    float inv = 1.0f / s_sum;
    if (tid < n_expert) s_prob[tid] *= inv;
    __syncthreads();
    // rank-based stable top-k
    if (tid < n_expert) {
        float my = s_prob[tid]; int rank = 0;
        for (int f = 0; f < n_expert; f++) {
            float pf = s_prob[f];
            if (pf > my || (pf == my && f < tid)) rank++;
        }
        if (rank < k) { ids[rank] = tid; weights[rank] = my; }
    }
    __syncthreads();
    // renormalize
    if (tid == 0) {
        float ws = 0; for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) ws += weights[i];
        float d = ws; if (d < 6.103515625e-05f) d = 6.103515625e-05f;
        float ri = 1.0f / d;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) weights[i] *= ri;
    }
}
} // anon

extern "C" {
void ix_router_top10(const float* logits, int n_expert, int k,
                     int32_t* ids, float* weights, cudaStream_t stream) {
    ix_router_top10_kernel<<<1, MAX_EXP, 0, stream>>>(logits, n_expert, k, ids, weights);
}
} // extern C
}} // ns
ENDOFFILE

$ cat > /home/claude/baloon/src/strata/kernels/cuda/ix_qsa_select.cu << 'ENDOFFILE'
// ix_qsa_select.cu -- QSA block scoring + top-k for BI-V100 (ivcore10)
// block_scores: score[b] = sum_h relu(<k_b, q_h>). Block R=4 tokens.
// block_topk: insertion-sort top-cap (radix is Phase 3).

#include "strata/kernels/cuda/ix_warp64.cuh"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cmath>

namespace strata { namespace kernels { namespace {
constexpr int QSA_R = 4;

__global__ void ix_block_scores_kernel(
    const float* __restrict__ k_pool, const float* __restrict__ q,
    const int32_t* __restrict__ step, int n_kv, int n_heads, int n_kv_heads,
    int head_dim, int max_blocks, float* __restrict__ scores) {
    const int b = (int)blockIdx.x;
    if (b >= max_blocks) return;
    const int tid = threadIdx.x;
    const int gqa = n_heads / n_kv_heads;
    int rp = (b + 1) * QSA_R - 1;
    if (rp >= n_kv) rp = n_kv - 1;
    float bscore = 0.0f;
    for (int h = 0; h < n_heads; h++) {
        int kvh = h / gqa;
        float dot = 0.0f;
        for (int d = tid; d < head_dim; d += (int)blockDim.x)
            dot += k_pool[((int64_t)rp * n_kv_heads + kvh) * head_dim + d] * q[(int64_t)h * head_dim + d];
        for (int o = IX_WARP_SIZE/2; o > 0; o >>= 1) dot += ix_shfl_xor(dot, o);
        __shared__ float sd[8];
        int wid = tid / IX_WARP_SIZE, lane = tid % IX_WARP_SIZE;
        if (lane == 0) sd[wid] = dot;
        __syncthreads();
        if (tid == 0) { float s = 0; int nw = ((int)blockDim.x + IX_WARP_SIZE - 1) / IX_WARP_SIZE; for (int w = 0; w < nw; w++) s += sd[w]; if (s > 0) bscore += s; }
        __syncthreads();
    }
    if (tid == 0) scores[b] = bscore;
}

__global__ void ix_block_topk_kernel(
    const float* __restrict__ scores, int max_blocks, int cap,
    int32_t* __restrict__ ids) {
    if (threadIdx.x != 0) return;
    // insertion sort for correctness (radix Phase 3)
    float top_s[128]; int32_t top_i[128];
    for (int i = 0; i < cap; i++) { top_s[i] = -1e30f; top_i[i] = -1; }
    for (int b = 0; b < max_blocks; b++) {
        float sc = scores[b];
        if (sc > top_s[cap - 1]) {
            int p = cap - 1;
            while (p > 0 && sc > top_s[p - 1]) { top_s[p] = top_s[p-1]; top_i[p] = top_i[p-1]; p--; }
            top_s[p] = sc; top_i[p] = b;
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < cap; i++) ids[i] = top_i[i];
}
} // anon

extern "C" {
void ix_block_scores(const float* k_pool, const float* q, const int32_t* step,
    int n_kv, int n_heads, int n_kv_heads, int head_dim, int max_blocks,
    float* scores, cudaStream_t stream) {
    ix_block_scores_kernel<<<max_blocks, 256, 0, stream>>>(k_pool, q, step, n_kv, n_heads, n_kv_heads, head_dim, max_blocks, scores);
}
void ix_block_topk(const float* scores, int max_blocks, int cap, int32_t* ids, cudaStream_t stream) {
    ix_block_topk_kernel<<<1, 1, 0, stream>>>(scores, max_blocks, cap, ids);
}
} // extern C
}} // ns

$ cat > /home/claude/baloon/src/strata/kernels/cuda/ix_sampler.cu << 'ENDOFFILE'
// ix_sampler.cu -- Sampler chain for BI-V100 (ivcore10, warp64)
// penalties -> temperature -> softmax -> top-k -> top-p -> Philox pick.
// Greedy argmax: separate parallel-reduction kernel.
// Philox 4x32-10 CBRNG for reproducibility.

#include "strata/kernels/cuda/ix_warp64.cuh"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cmath>

namespace strata { namespace kernels { namespace {

struct Philox4x32 {
    uint32_t ctr[4]; uint32_t key[2];
    __device__ void init(uint64_t seed, uint64_t seq) {
        ctr[0]=(uint32_t)seq; ctr[1]=(uint32_t)(seq>>32); ctr[2]=0; ctr[3]=0;
        key[0]=(uint32_t)seed; key[1]=(uint32_t)(seed>>32);
    }
    __device__ void rp(uint32_t& L, uint32_t& R, uint32_t k) {
        uint64_t p=(uint64_t)0xD2511F53u*(uint64_t)L; L=(uint32_t)(p>>32)^R^k; R=(uint32_t)p;
    }
    __device__ float uniform() {
        uint32_t k0=key[0],k1=key[1];
        for(int r=0;r<10;r++){rp(ctr[0],ctr[1],k0);rp(ctr[2],ctr[3],k1);k0+=0x9E3779B9u;k1+=0xBB67AE85u;}
        return (float)(ctr[0]>>8)*(1.0f/16777216.0f);
    }
};

__global__ void ix_greedy_argmax_kernel(const float* __restrict__ logits, int nv, int32_t* __restrict__ out) {
    __shared__ float sm[8]; __shared__ int si[8];
    const int tid = threadIdx.x;
    float mx = -1e30f; int mi = 0;
    for (int i = tid; i < nv; i += (int)blockDim.x) { float v = logits[i]; if (v > mx) { mx = v; mi = i; } }
    for (int o = IX_WARP_SIZE/2; o > 0; o >>= 1) {
        float om = ix_shfl_xor(mx, o);
        int oi = (int)__float_as_uint(ix_shfl_xor(__uint_as_float((unsigned)mi), o));
        if (om > mx || (om == mx && oi < mi)) { mx = om; mi = oi; }
    }
    int wid = tid / IX_WARP_SIZE, lane = tid % IX_WARP_SIZE;
    if (lane == 0) { sm[wid] = mx; si[wid] = mi; }
    __syncthreads();
    if (tid == 0) {
        float b = sm[0]; int bi = si[0];
        int nw = ((int)blockDim.x + IX_WARP_SIZE - 1) / IX_WARP_SIZE;
        for (int w = 1; w < nw; w++) if (sm[w] > b || (sm[w] == b && si[w] < bi)) { b = sm[w]; bi = si[w]; }
        out[0] = bi;
    }
}

__global__ void ix_sampler_kernel(
    float* __restrict__ logits, int nv,
    float temp, float top_p, int top_k,
    float pen_rep, float pen_freq, float pen_pres,
    const int32_t* __restrict__ hist, int hlen, uint64_t seed, int32_t* __restrict__ out) {
    if (threadIdx.x != 0) return;
    // 1. penalties
    for (int h = 0; h < hlen; h++) {
        int tok = hist[h]; if (tok < 0 || tok >= nv) continue;
        float l = logits[tok];
        if (l <= 0) l *= pen_rep; else l /= pen_rep;
        int cnt = 0; for (int j = 0; j <= h; j++) if (hist[j] == tok) cnt++;
        l -= (float)cnt * pen_freq;
        if (cnt > 0) l -= pen_pres;
        logits[tok] = l;
    }
    // 2. temperature
    if (temp > 0 && temp != 1.0f) { float it = 1.0f / temp; for (int i = 0; i < nv; i++) logits[i] *= it; }
    // 3. softmax
    float mx = logits[0]; for (int i = 1; i < nv; i++) if (logits[i] > mx) mx = logits[i];
    float se = 0; for (int i = 0; i < nv; i++) { float e = expf(logits[i] - mx); logits[i] = e; se += e; }
    float is = 1.0f / se; for (int i = 0; i < nv; i++) logits[i] *= is;
    // 4. top-k: zero out below k-th
    if (top_k > 0 && top_k < nv) {
        // find k-th largest by repeated passes
        float prev = 2.0f, kth = -1.0f;
        for (int pass = 0; pass < top_k; pass++) {
            float best = -1.0f;
            for (int i = 0; i < nv; i++) { float p = logits[i]; if (p < prev && p > best) best = p; }
            if (best < 0) break; kth = best; prev = best;
        }
        if (kth >= 0) for (int i = 0; i < nv; i++) if (logits[i] < kth) logits[i] = 0;
    }
    // 5. top-p: zero out tail beyond cumulative threshold
    if (top_p > 0 && top_p < 1.0f) {
        float cum = 0, thr = -1.0f, prev = 2.0f;
        while (cum < top_p) {
            float best = -1.0f;
            for (int i = 0; i < nv; i++) { float p = logits[i]; if (p > 0 && p <= prev && p > best) best = p; }
            if (best <= 0) break;
            for (int i = 0; i < nv; i++) if (logits[i] == best) { cum += best; if (cum >= top_p) { thr = best; break; } }
            if (cum >= top_p) break; prev = best;
        }
        if (thr > 0) for (int i = 0; i < nv; i++) if (logits[i] < thr) logits[i] = 0;
    }
    // 6. renormalize
    float rs = 0; for (int i = 0; i < nv; i++) rs += logits[i];
    if (rs > 0) { float ri = 1.0f / rs; for (int i = 0; i < nv; i++) logits[i] *= ri; }
    // 7. Philox pick
    Philox4x32 rng; rng.init(seed, 0); float u = rng.uniform();
    float c = 0; int pick = nv - 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < nv; i++) { c += logits[i]; if (c >= u) { pick = i; break; } }
    out[0] = pick;
}
} // anon

extern "C" {
void ix_greedy_argmax(const float* logits, int nv, int32_t* out, cudaStream_t stream) {
    ix_greedy_argmax_kernel<<<1, 512, 0, stream>>>(logits, nv, out);
}
void ix_sampler(float* logits, int nv, float temp, float top_p, int top_k,
    float pen_rep, float pen_freq, float pen_pres, const int32_t* hist, int hlen,
    uint64_t seed, int32_t* out, cudaStream_t stream) {
    ix_sampler_kernel<<<1, 1, 0, stream>>>(logits, nv, temp, top_p, top_k, pen_rep, pen_freq, pen_pres, hist, hlen, seed, out);
}
} // extern C
}} // ns
ENDOFFILE

$ cat > /home/claude/baloon/include/strata/kernels/cuda/ix_unit3_ops.h << 'ENDOFFILE'
// ix_unit3_ops.h -- Unit 3 CUDA kernel APIs for BI-V100 (ivcore10)
// RoPE, KV Q8 cache, router top-10, QSA select, sampler.
#pragma once

// test_unit3_cuda.cu -- Integration tests for unit 3 CUDA kernels (BI-V100)
#include "strata/kernels/cuda/ix_unit3_ops.h"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <vector>

static int g_pass = 0, g_fail = 0;
#define CHECK_CUDA(call) do { cudaError_t e=(call); if(e!=cudaSuccess){printf("  CUDA err %s:%d: %s\n",__FILE__,__LINE__,cudaGetErrorString(e));g_fail++;return;}}while(0)

static void test_rope() {
    printf("  [1] RoPE NeoX ... ");
    const int nh=2,hd=8,nr=8,mp=16,half=nr/2,tot=nh*hd;
    std::vector<float> hcos(mp*half),hsin(mp*half);
    for(int p=0;p<mp;p++) for(int d=0;d<half;d++){
        float th=(float)p*powf(1e7f,-2.0f*d/nr);
        hcos[p*half+d]=cosf(th); hsin[p*half+d]=sinf(th);
    }
    std::vector<float> hx(tot); for(int i=0;i<tot;i++) hx[i]=(float)(i+1);
    int32_t hp=3;
    float *dx,*dc,*ds; int32_t *dp;
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&dx,tot*4)); CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&dc,mp*half*4));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&ds,mp*half*4)); CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&dp,4));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(dx,hx.data(),tot*4,cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(dc,hcos.data(),mp*half*4,cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(ds,hsin.data(),mp*half*4,cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(dp,&hp,4,cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    ix_rope_neox(dx,dp,dc,ds,nh,hd,nr,mp,0);
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
    std::vector<float> ho(tot);
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(ho.data(),dx,tot*4,cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
    float c0=hcos[3*half+0],s0=hsin[3*half+0];
    float exp0=hx[0]*c0-hx[0+half]*s0;
    if(fabsf(ho[0]-exp0)>1e-4f){printf("FAIL: got %.6f exp %.6f\n",ho[0],exp0);g_fail++;}
    else{printf("PASS\n");g_pass++;}
    cudaFree(dx);cudaFree(dc);cudaFree(ds);cudaFree(dp);
}

static void test_greedy() {
    printf("  [2] Greedy argmax ... ");
    const int nv=1024;
    std::vector<float> hl(nv,0.0f); hl[42]=10.0f; hl[100]=9.99f;
    float *dl; int32_t *dout;
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&dl,nv*4)); CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&dout,4));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(dl,hl.data(),nv*4,cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    ix_greedy_argmax(dl,nv,dout,0);
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
    int32_t r; CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(&r,dout,4,cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
    if(r!=42){printf("FAIL: got %d\n",r);g_fail++;}else{printf("PASS\n");g_pass++;}
    cudaFree(dl);cudaFree(dout);
}

static void test_router() {
    printf("  [3] Router top-10 ... ");
    const int ne=64,k=10;
    std::vector<float> hl(ne); for(int i=0;i<ne;i++) hl[i]=(float)(i*7%64);
    hl[9]=100.0f;
    float *dl,*dw; int32_t *di;
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&dl,ne*4)); CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&di,k*4)); CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&dw,k*4));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(dl,hl.data(),ne*4,cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    ix_router_top10(dl,ne,k,di,dw,0);
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
    std::vector<int32_t> hi(k); std::vector<float> hw(k);
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(hi.data(),di,k*4,cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(hw.data(),dw,k*4,cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
    float ws=0; for(int i=0;i<k;i++) ws+=hw[i];
    if(hi[0]!=9){printf("FAIL: top=%d\n",hi[0]);g_fail++;}
    else if(fabsf(ws-1.0f)>1e-3f){printf("FAIL: wsum=%.4f\n",ws);g_fail++;}
    else{printf("PASS (top=%d wsum=%.4f)\n",hi[0],ws);g_pass++;}
    cudaFree(dl);cudaFree(di);cudaFree(dw);
}

static void test_block_scores() {
    printf("  [4] Block scores ... ");
    const int nkv=8,nh=2,nkvh=2,hd=4,mb=2;
    std::vector<float> hk(nkv*nkvh*hd,1.0f),hq(nh*hd,1.0f);
    float *dk,*dq,*ds; int32_t *dst;
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&dk,hk.size()*4)); CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&dq,hq.size()*4));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&ds,mb*4)); CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&dst,4));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(dk,hk.data(),hk.size()*4,cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(dq,hq.data(),hq.size()*4,cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    int32_t st=nkv; CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(dst,&st,4,cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    ix_block_scores(dk,dq,dst,nkv,nh,nkvh,hd,mb,ds,0);
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
    std::vector<float> hs(mb);
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(hs.data(),ds,mb*4,cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
    if(hs[0]<=0){printf("FAIL: s[0]=%.4f\n",hs[0]);g_fail++;}
    else{printf("PASS (scores=[%.2f,%.2f])\n",hs[0],hs[1]);g_pass++;}
    cudaFree(dk);cudaFree(dq);cudaFree(ds);cudaFree(dst);
}

int main() {
    printf("=== infccl Unit 3 (round 2): CUDA Kernel Tests (BI-V100) ===\n\n");
    int dc=0; cudaGetDeviceCount(&dc);
    printf("GPUs detected: %d\n",dc);
    if(!dc){printf("No GPU.\n");return 1;}
    cudaDeviceProp p; cudaGetDeviceProperties(&p,0);
    printf("  GPU 0: %s\n\n",p.name);
    test_rope(); test_greedy(); test_router(); test_block_scores();
    printf("\n=== Results: %d passed, %d failed ===\n",g_pass,g_fail);
    return g_fail>0?1:0;
}
ENDOFFILE

// ix_fused_gdn.cu -- Fused GDN step+norm for BI-V100 (ivcore10, warp64)
// Fused: state update (S x S matrix), query-key product, gate, output, GroupNorm.
// S_col <- g * S_col + k_r * delta_c; kv_c = sum_r S[r,c] * k[r]
// o_c = sum_r S[r,c] * q[r] * rsqrt(S_dim); y = gamma * (o - mu) / sqrt(var + eps)

#include "strata/kernels/cuda/ix_warp64.cuh"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cmath>

namespace strata { namespace kernels { namespace {

// Per-head fused kernel. One block per head.
// blockDim.x = S (state dimension, e.g. 160), handles one column each.
__global__ void ix_fused_gdn_step_norm_kernel(
    float* __restrict__ state,        // [n_head, S, S] — transposed layout
    const float* __restrict__ q,      // [n_head * S]
    const float* __restrict__ k,      // [n_head * S]
    const float* __restrict__ v,      // [n_head * S]
    const float* __restrict__ gate,   // [n_head]
    const float* __restrict__ beta,   // [n_head]
    const float* __restrict__ z,      // [n_head * S] for sigmoid gating
    const float* __restrict__ gamma,  // [n_head * S] norm weights
    float eps,
    float* __restrict__ result,       // [n_head * S]
    int n_head, int S
) {
    const int h = (int)blockIdx.x;
    const int c = threadIdx.x;
    if (h >= n_head || c >= S) return;

    const float g = gate[h];
    const float b = beta[h];
    const float q_val = q[h * S + c];
    const float k_val = k[h * S + c];
    const float v_val = v[h * S + c];

    // State base for this head: state[h, :, c] in (n_head, S, S) layout
    const int64_t state_base = (int64_t)h * S * S;

    // 1. Compute kv_c = sum_r state[h,r,c] * k[r]
    float kv_c = 0.0f;
    for (int r = 0; r < S; r++) {
        kv_c += state[state_base + r * S + c] * k[h * S + r];
    }

    // 2. Compute delta_c = (v_c - g * kv_c) * beta
    float delta_c = (v_val - g * kv_c) * b;

    // 3. Update state: state[h,r,c] = g * state[h,r,c] + k[r] * delta_c
    for (int r = 0; r < S; r++) {
        float s = state[state_base + r * S + c];
        state[state_base + r * S + c] = g * s + k[h * S + r] * delta_c;
    }

    // 4. Compute o_c = sum_r state[h,r,c] * q[r] * rsqrt(S)
    float o_c = 0.0f;
    for (int r = 0; r < S; r++) {
        o_c += state[state_base + r * S + c] * q[h * S + r];
    }
    o_c *= rsqrtf((float)S);

    // 5. GroupNorm: y = gamma * (o - mean) / sqrt(var + eps)
    // Compute mean and var across columns via shared memory
    __shared__ float s_sum[1];
    __shared__ float s_sum2[1];

    // Atomic add for mean computation
    float contrib = o_c;
    // Use warp reduction + cross-warp shared memory
    for (int offset = IX_WARP_SIZE / 2; offset > 0; offset >>= 1)
        contrib += ix_shfl_xor(contrib, offset);

    int wid = c / IX_WARP_SIZE, lane = c % IX_WARP_SIZE;
    __shared__ float s_warp[4];
    if (lane == 0) s_warp[wid] = contrib;
    __syncthreads();
    if (c == 0) {
        float total = 0;
        int nw = (S + IX_WARP_SIZE - 1) / IX_WARP_SIZE;
        for (int w = 0; w < nw; w++) total += s_warp[w];
        s_sum[0] = total;
    }
    __syncthreads();
    float mean = s_sum[0] / (float)S;

    float diff = o_c - mean;
    float diff2 = diff * diff;
    for (int offset = IX_WARP_SIZE / 2; offset > 0; offset >>= 1)
        diff2 += ix_shfl_xor(diff2, offset);
    if (lane == 0) s_warp[wid] = diff2;
    __syncthreads();
    if (c == 0) {
        float total = 0;
        int nw = (S + IX_WARP_SIZE - 1) / IX_WARP_SIZE;
        for (int w = 0; w < nw; w++) total += s_warp[w];
        s_sum2[0] = total;
    }
    __syncthreads();
    float var = s_sum2[0] / (float)S;

    float normed = (o_c - mean) * rsqrtf(var + eps);
    float y = gamma[h * S + c] * normed;

    // 6. Sigmoid gating: result = y * sigmoid(z)
    float z_val = z[h * S + c];
    float sig = 1.0f / (1.0f + expf(-z_val));
    result[h * S + c] = y * sig;
}

} // anon

extern "C" {
void ix_fused_gdn_step_norm(
    float* state, const float* q, const float* k, const float* v,
    const float* gate, const float* beta, const float* z,
    const float* gamma, float eps, float* result,
    int n_head, int S, cudaStream_t stream) {
    ix_fused_gdn_step_norm_kernel<<<n_head, S, 0, stream>>>(
        state, q, k, v, gate, beta, z, gamma, eps, result, n_head, S);
}
} // extern C
}} // ns
ENDOFFILE

//   R'[c,d] = R[c,d] + block_out[d] * 2*sigmoid(inject[c]/hc)

#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cmath>

namespace strata { namespace kernels { namespace {

// ─── gr_norm: per-stream RMSNorm ─────────────────────────────────
// One block per stream. blockDim.x threads split n_embd elements.
__global__ void ix_gr_norm_kernel(
    const float* __restrict__ R,      // [hc, n_embd]
    const float* __restrict__ norm_w, // [hc * n_embd] stored as (1+w)
    float eps, int n_embd, int hc,
    float* __restrict__ xn            // [hc, n_embd] output
) {
    const int c = (int)blockIdx.x;
    if (c >= hc) return;
    const int tid = threadIdx.x;
    const int64_t base = (int64_t)c * n_embd;
    // Sum of squares
    float ss = 0.0f;
    for (int d = tid; d < n_embd; d += (int)blockDim.x) {
        float v = R[base + d];
        ss += v * v;
    }
    for (int o = IX_WARP_SIZE/2; o > 0; o >>= 1) ss += ix_shfl_xor(ss, o);
    __shared__ float s_ss[8];
    int wid = tid / IX_WARP_SIZE, lane = tid % IX_WARP_SIZE;
    if (lane == 0) s_ss[wid] = ss;
    __syncthreads();
    if (tid == 0) {
        float t = 0; int nw = ((int)blockDim.x + IX_WARP_SIZE - 1) / IX_WARP_SIZE;
        for (int w = 0; w < nw; w++) t += s_ss[w];
        s_ss[0] = t;
    }
    __syncthreads();
    float rms_inv = rsqrtf(s_ss[0] / (float)n_embd + eps);
    for (int d = tid; d < n_embd; d += (int)blockDim.x) {
        xn[base + d] = R[base + d] * rms_inv * norm_w[base + d];
    }
}

// ─── gr_mean: mixed[d] = (1/hc) * sum_c gated[c*N+d] ────────────
__global__ void ix_gr_mean_kernel(
    const float* __restrict__ gated, // [hc, n_embd]
    int n_embd, int hc,
    float* __restrict__ mixed        // [n_embd]
) {
    const int d = (int)blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (d >= n_embd) return;
    float sum = 0.0f;
    for (int c = 0; c < hc; c++) {
        sum += gated[(int64_t)c * n_embd + d];
    }
    mixed[d] = sum / (float)hc;
}

// ─── gr_write: R'[c,d] = R[c,d] + block_out[d] * w[c] ──────────
// w[c] = 2 * sigmoid(inject[c] / hc)
__global__ void ix_gr_write_kernel(
    const float* __restrict__ R,         // [hc, n_embd]
    const float* __restrict__ block_out, // [n_embd]
    const float* __restrict__ inject,    // [hc]
    int n_embd, int hc,
    float* __restrict__ R_out            // [hc, n_embd]
) {
    const int c = (int)blockIdx.y;
    const int d = (int)blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (c >= hc || d >= n_embd) return;
    float inj = inject[c];
    float w = 2.0f / (1.0f + expf(-inj / (float)hc));
    R_out[(int64_t)c * n_embd + d] = R[(int64_t)c * n_embd + d] + block_out[d] * w;
}

} // anon

extern "C" {
void ix_gr_norm(const float* R, const float* norm_w, float eps,
                int n_embd, int hc, float* xn, cudaStream_t stream) {
    int threads = 256;
    ix_gr_norm_kernel<<<hc, threads, 0, stream>>>(R, norm_w, eps, n_embd, hc, xn);
}

void ix_gr_mean(const float* gated, int n_embd, int hc,
                float* mixed, cudaStream_t stream) {
    int threads = 256;
    int blocks = (n_embd + threads - 1) / threads;
    ix_gr_mean_kernel<<<blocks, threads, 0, stream>>>(gated, n_embd, hc, mixed);
}

void ix_gr_write(const float* R, const float* block_out, const float* inject,
                 int n_embd, int hc, float* R_out, cudaStream_t stream) {
    int threads = 256;
    dim3 grid((n_embd + threads - 1) / threads, hc);
    ix_gr_write_kernel<<<grid, threads, 0, stream>>>(R, block_out, inject, n_embd, hc, R_out);
}
} // extern C
}} // ns
ENDOFFILE

// ix_quantize_act.cu -- Activation quantization (Q8_0, Q8_0_scaled) for BI-V100
// Q8_0: per-32-element block, d16=f16(amax/127), q=rint(x/d32) in double precision.
// Three subtleties: d32 != d16; division in float64+rint; dequant uses d16 not d32.
// Q8_0_scaled: same quant but with fp32 scales for hit path parity.

#include "strata/kernels/cuda/ix_warp64.cuh"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cmath>

namespace strata { namespace kernels { namespace {

constexpr int Q8_0_BLOCK = 32;
// Q8_0 block layout: 2 bytes (fp16 scale) + 32 bytes (int8 quants) = 34 bytes
constexpr int Q8_0_BYTES = 34;

// ─── Q8_0 quantize kernel ───────────────────────────────────────
// One warp per Q8_0 block (32 elements, one per thread in warp64 first 32 lanes).
__global__ void ix_quantize_q8_0_kernel(
    const float* __restrict__ x,
    uint8_t* __restrict__ out,       // packed Q8_0 blocks
    int64_t n_elements
) {
    const int64_t block_id = (int64_t)blockIdx.x * (blockDim.x / Q8_0_BLOCK) + threadIdx.x / Q8_0_BLOCK;
    const int lane = threadIdx.x % Q8_0_BLOCK;
    const int64_t base = block_id * Q8_0_BLOCK;

    if (base >= n_elements) return;

    float val = 0.0f;
    if (base + lane < n_elements) val = x[base + lane];

    // Find amax across 32 elements via warp shuffle (within sub-warp of 32)
    float amax = val < 0 ? -val : val;
    for (int o = 16; o > 0; o >>= 1) {
        float other = ix_shfl_xor(amax, o);
        if (other > amax) amax = other;
    }
    // Lane 0 has amax
    amax = ix_shfl(amax, 0);  // broadcast

    float d32 = amax / 127.0f;
    uint16_t d16 = ix_f32_to_f16_bits(d32);

    // Quantize: rint(double(val) / double(d32))
    int8_t q = 0;
    if (d32 > 0.0f) {
        double dval = (double)val;
        double dd32 = (double)d32;
        int qi = (int)rint(dval / dd32);
        qi = qi < -128 ? -128 : (qi > 127 ? 127 : qi);
        q = (int8_t)qi;
    }

    // Write block: [d16 (2 bytes), qs[32] (32 bytes)]
    uint8_t* block_out = out + block_id * Q8_0_BYTES;
    if (lane == 0) {
        block_out[0] = (uint8_t)(d16 & 0xFF);
        block_out[1] = (uint8_t)(d16 >> 8);
    }
    block_out[2 + lane] = (uint8_t)q;
}

// ─── Q8_0 dequantize kernel ─────────────────────────────────────
__global__ void ix_dequant_q8_0_kernel(
    const uint8_t* __restrict__ blocks,
    float* __restrict__ out,
    int64_t n_elements
) {
    const int64_t block_id = (int64_t)blockIdx.x * (blockDim.x / Q8_0_BLOCK) + threadIdx.x / Q8_0_BLOCK;
    const int lane = threadIdx.x % Q8_0_BLOCK;
    const int64_t base = block_id * Q8_0_BLOCK;

    if (base >= n_elements) return;

    const uint8_t* blk = blocks + block_id * Q8_0_BYTES;
    uint16_t d16 = (uint16_t)blk[0] | ((uint16_t)blk[1] << 8);
    float d = ix_f16_to_f32_bits(d16);
    int8_t q = (int8_t)blk[2 + lane];

    if (base + lane < n_elements) {
        out[base + lane] = (float)q * d;
    }
}

// ─── Q8_0_scaled: same quant but fp32 scale for hit path ─────────
// Layout: 4 bytes (fp32 scale) + 32 bytes (int8 quants) = 36 bytes
constexpr int Q8_0S_BYTES = 36;

__global__ void ix_quantize_q8_0_scaled_kernel(
    const float* __restrict__ x,
    uint8_t* __restrict__ out,
    float* __restrict__ scales,      // [n_blocks] fp32 scales
    int64_t n_elements
) {
    const int64_t block_id = (int64_t)blockIdx.x * (blockDim.x / Q8_0_BLOCK) + threadIdx.x / Q8_0_BLOCK;
    const int lane = threadIdx.x % Q8_0_BLOCK;
    const int64_t base = block_id * Q8_0_BLOCK;

    if (base >= n_elements) return;

    float val = 0.0f;
    if (base + lane < n_elements) val = x[base + lane];

    float amax = val < 0 ? -val : val;
    for (int o = 16; o > 0; o >>= 1) {
        float other = ix_shfl_xor(amax, o);
        if (other > amax) amax = other;
    }
    amax = ix_shfl(amax, 0);

    float d32 = amax / 127.0f;

    int8_t q = 0;
    if (d32 > 0.0f) {
        int qi = (int)roundf(val / d32);
        qi = qi < -128 ? -128 : (qi > 127 ? 127 : qi);
        q = (int8_t)qi;
    }

    uint8_t* block_out = out + block_id * Q8_0_BLOCK;
    block_out[lane] = (uint8_t)q;
    if (lane == 0 && scales) {
        scales[block_id] = d32;
    }
}

} // anon

extern "C" {
void ix_quantize_q8_0(const float* x, uint8_t* out, int64_t n,
                      cudaStream_t stream) {
    int64_t n_blocks = (n + Q8_0_BLOCK - 1) / Q8_0_BLOCK;
    // 2 blocks per warp (64 threads / 32 = 2)
    int threads = 256;
    int blocks_per_tb = threads / Q8_0_BLOCK;
    int grid = (int)((n_blocks + blocks_per_tb - 1) / blocks_per_tb);
    ix_quantize_q8_0_kernel<<<grid, threads, 0, stream>>>(x, out, n);
}

void ix_dequant_q8_0(const uint8_t* blocks, float* out, int64_t n,
                     cudaStream_t stream) {
    int64_t n_blocks = (n + Q8_0_BLOCK - 1) / Q8_0_BLOCK;
    int threads = 256;
    int blocks_per_tb = threads / Q8_0_BLOCK;
    int grid = (int)((n_blocks + blocks_per_tb - 1) / blocks_per_tb);
    ix_dequant_q8_0_kernel<<<grid, threads, 0, stream>>>(blocks, out, n);
}

void ix_quantize_q8_0_scaled(const float* x, uint8_t* out, float* scales,
                             int64_t n, cudaStream_t stream) {
    int64_t n_blocks = (n + Q8_0_BLOCK - 1) / Q8_0_BLOCK;
    int threads = 256;
    int blocks_per_tb = threads / Q8_0_BLOCK;
    int grid = (int)((n_blocks + blocks_per_tb - 1) / blocks_per_tb);
    ix_quantize_q8_0_scaled_kernel<<<grid, threads, 0, stream>>>(x, out, scales, n);
}
} // extern C
}} // ns
ENDOFFILE

// ix_qsa_decode_attn.cu -- QSA decode attention for BI-V100 (ivcore10, warp64)
// Sparse attention over selected KV cells: score -> softmax -> weighted sum.
// One block per head. Scores in shared memory. No __float2half (use f16_bits).
// score[j] = dot(q[h], k[j]) * rsqrt(head_dim)
// attn[j] = softmax(score[j]) over selected cells
// out[h] = sum_j attn[j] * v[j]

#include "strata/kernels/cuda/ix_warp64.cuh"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cmath>

namespace strata { namespace kernels { namespace {

// One block per query head. Threads split over head_dim for dot products.
// Two passes: (1) score all selected cells, (2) softmax + weighted sum.
__global__ void ix_qsa_decode_attn_kernel(
    const float* __restrict__ q,         // [n_heads, head_dim]
    const uint16_t* __restrict__ k_sel,  // [n_sel, n_kv_heads, head_dim] fp16
    const uint16_t* __restrict__ v_sel,  // [n_sel, n_kv_heads, head_dim] fp16
    int n_heads, int n_kv_heads, int head_dim,
    int n_sel,
    float* __restrict__ out              // [n_heads, head_dim]
) {
    const int h = (int)blockIdx.x;
    if (h >= n_heads) return;
    const int tid = threadIdx.x;
    const int kv_h = h / (n_heads / n_kv_heads);  // GQA mapping

    extern __shared__ float shmem[];  // [n_sel] scores + [n_sel] attn weights
    float* s_scores = shmem;

    float scale = rsqrtf((float)head_dim);

    // Pass 1: compute scores for all selected cells
    for (int j = 0; j < n_sel; j++) {
        float dot = 0.0f;
        for (int d = tid; d < head_dim; d += (int)blockDim.x) {
            float q_val = q[(int64_t)h * head_dim + d];
            uint16_t k_bits = k_sel[((int64_t)j * n_kv_heads + kv_h) * head_dim + d];
            float k_val = ix_f16_to_f32_bits(k_bits);
            dot += q_val * k_val;
        }
        // Warp reduce
        for (int o = IX_WARP_SIZE / 2; o > 0; o >>= 1) dot += ix_shfl_xor(dot, o);
        // Cross-warp reduce
        __shared__ float s_dot[8];
        int wid = tid / IX_WARP_SIZE, lane = tid % IX_WARP_SIZE;
        if (lane == 0) s_dot[wid] = dot;
        __syncthreads();
        if (tid == 0) {
            float total = 0;
            int nw = ((int)blockDim.x + IX_WARP_SIZE - 1) / IX_WARP_SIZE;
            for (int w = 0; w < nw; w++) total += s_dot[w];
            s_scores[j] = total * scale;
        }
        __syncthreads();
    }

    // Pass 2: softmax over scores
    if (tid == 0) {
        float mx = s_scores[0];
        for (int j = 1; j < n_sel; j++) if (s_scores[j] > mx) mx = s_scores[j];
        float se = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < n_sel; j++) {
            float e = expf(s_scores[j] - mx);
            s_scores[j] = e;
            se += e;
        }
        float inv = 1.0f / se;
        for (int j = 0; j < n_sel; j++) s_scores[j] *= inv;
    }
    __syncthreads();

    // Pass 3: weighted sum of V
    for (int d = tid; d < head_dim; d += (int)blockDim.x) {
        float acc = 0.0f;
        for (int j = 0; j < n_sel; j++) {
            uint16_t v_bits = v_sel[((int64_t)j * n_kv_heads + kv_h) * head_dim + d];
            float v_val = ix_f16_to_f32_bits(v_bits);
            acc += s_scores[j] * v_val;
        }
        out[(int64_t)h * head_dim + d] = acc;
    }
}

} // anon

extern "C" {
void ix_qsa_decode_attn(
    const float* q, const uint16_t* k_sel, const uint16_t* v_sel,
    int n_heads, int n_kv_heads, int head_dim, int n_sel,
    float* out, cudaStream_t stream) {
    int threads = 256;
    // Shared memory: n_sel floats for scores
    size_t shmem_bytes = (size_t)n_sel * sizeof(float);
    ix_qsa_decode_attn_kernel<<<n_heads, threads, shmem_bytes, stream>>>(
        q, k_sel, v_sel, n_heads, n_kv_heads, head_dim, n_sel, out);
}
} // extern C
}} // ns
ENDOFFILE

// ix_iq_kernels.cu -- IQ (importance quantization) kernels for BI-V100 (ivcore10)
// IQ4_NL dequant: codebook[nibble] * scale + offset. No -8 subtraction.
// Q8_K dot product: sum_g scale_a[g] * scale_b[g] * sum_i a[i]*b[i]

#include "strata/kernels/cuda/ix_warp64.cuh"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cmath>

namespace strata { namespace kernels { namespace {

// IQ4_NL codebook (kvalues_iq4nl from ggml)
__device__ __constant__ float c_iq4nl[16] = {
    -1.0f, -0.6961928009986877f, -0.5250730514526367f, -0.39491748809814453f,
    -0.28444138169288635f, -0.18477343022823334f, -0.09105003625154495f, 0.0f,
     0.07958029955625534f,  0.16093020141124725f,  0.24611abordar, 0.33791524171829224f,
     0.44070982933044434f,  0.5626170039176941f,   0.7229568362236023f,  1.0f
};

// IQ4_NL dequantize: each byte holds two 4-bit codes
// block layout: [scale(fp16, 2B)] [codes(n/2 bytes)]
__global__ void ix_iq4nl_dequant_kernel(
    const uint8_t* __restrict__ data,
    float* __restrict__ out,
    int64_t n
) {
    const int64_t i = (int64_t)blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    const int64_t pair = i;  // each thread handles one byte = 2 values
    const int64_t out_idx = pair * 2;
    if (out_idx >= n) return;

    // Find which block this pair belongs to (32 elements per block)
    const int64_t block_elems = 32;
    const int64_t block_bytes = 2 + block_elems / 2;  // 2 (scale) + 16 (codes) = 18
    const int64_t block_id = out_idx / block_elems;
    const int64_t in_block = out_idx % block_elems;
    const int64_t byte_in_block = in_block / 2;

    const uint8_t* blk = data + block_id * block_bytes;
    uint16_t scale_bits = (uint16_t)blk[0] | ((uint16_t)blk[1] << 8);
    float scale = ix_f16_to_f32_bits(scale_bits);

    uint8_t byte = blk[2 + byte_in_block];
    int lo = byte & 0x0F;
    int hi = (byte >> 4) & 0x0F;

    if (out_idx < n) out[out_idx] = c_iq4nl[lo] * scale;
    if (out_idx + 1 < n) out[out_idx + 1] = c_iq4nl[hi] * scale;
}

// Q8_K dot product: dot(a, b) = sum_g scale_a[g] * scale_b[g] * sum_i a[i]*b[i]
// Q8_K block: 256 values, 8 groups of 32, fp32 scale per group
// Layout: [d(fp32, 4B)] [groups: 8 x {scale(fp32,4B), qs(int8,32B)}]
// Total: 4 + 8*(4+32) = 292 bytes per block
__global__ void ix_vec_dot_q8k_kernel(
    const uint8_t* __restrict__ a_blocks,
    const uint8_t* __restrict__ b_blocks,
    float* __restrict__ result,
    int64_t n_blocks
) {
    // One thread per block for correctness. Phase 3 parallelizes.
    const int64_t bid = (int64_t)blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (bid >= n_blocks) return;

    const int Q8K_BLOCK = 292;
    const uint8_t* a = a_blocks + bid * Q8K_BLOCK;
    const uint8_t* b = b_blocks + bid * Q8K_BLOCK;

    // Global scale (d)
    float d_a, d_b;
    memcpy(&d_a, a, 4);
    memcpy(&d_b, b, 4);

    float dot = 0.0f;
    for (int g = 0; g < 8; g++) {
        const uint8_t* ga = a + 4 + g * 36;
        const uint8_t* gb = b + 4 + g * 36;

        float sa, sb;
        memcpy(&sa, ga, 4);
        memcpy(&sb, gb, 4);

        int32_t isum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++) {
            isum += (int32_t)(int8_t)ga[4 + i] * (int32_t)(int8_t)gb[4 + i];
        }
        dot += sa * sb * (float)isum;
    }
    result[bid] = dot * d_a * d_b;
}

} // anon

extern "C" {
void ix_iq4nl_dequant(const uint8_t* data, float* out, int64_t n,
                      cudaStream_t stream) {
    int64_t n_pairs = (n + 1) / 2;
    int threads = 256;
    int grid = (int)((n_pairs + threads - 1) / threads);
    ix_iq4nl_dequant_kernel<<<grid, threads, 0, stream>>>(data, out, n);
}

void ix_vec_dot_q8k(const uint8_t* a, const uint8_t* b, float* result,
                    int64_t n_blocks, cudaStream_t stream) {
    int threads = 64;
    int grid = (int)((n_blocks + threads - 1) / threads);
    ix_vec_dot_q8k_kernel<<<grid, threads, 0, stream>>>(a, b, result, n_blocks);
}
} // extern C
}} // ns
ENDOFFILE
