// test_unit4_cuda.cu -- Integration tests for unit 4 CUDA kernels (BI-V100)
#include "strata/kernels/cuda/ix_unit4_ops.h"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <cmath>
#include <vector>

static int g_pass = 0, g_fail = 0;
#define CHECK_CUDA(c) do{cudaError_t e=(c);if(e!=cudaSuccess){printf("  CUDA err %s:%d: %s\n",__FILE__,__LINE__,cudaGetErrorString(e));g_fail++;return;}}while(0)

static void test_gr_write() {
    printf("  [1] GR write (zero inject = plain add) ... ");
    const int ne = 8, hc = 4;
    std::vector<float> hR(hc * ne, 1.0f), hbo(ne, 2.0f), hinj(hc, 0.0f);
    float *dR, *dbo, *dinj, *dout;
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&dR, hc*ne*4)); CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&dbo, ne*4));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&dinj, hc*4)); CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&dout, hc*ne*4));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(dR, hR.data(), hc*ne*4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(dbo, hbo.data(), ne*4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(dinj, hinj.data(), hc*4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    ix_gr_write(dR, dbo, dinj, ne, hc, dout, 0);
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
    std::vector<float> ho(hc * ne);
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(ho.data(), dout, hc*ne*4, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
    // w = 2*sigmoid(0/4) = 2*0.5 = 1.0, so R'[c,d] = 1 + 2*1 = 3.0
    if (fabsf(ho[0] - 3.0f) > 1e-4f) { printf("FAIL: got %.4f exp 3.0\n", ho[0]); g_fail++; }
    else { printf("PASS\n"); g_pass++; }
    cudaFree(dR); cudaFree(dbo); cudaFree(dinj); cudaFree(dout);
}

static void test_quantize_q8_0() {
    printf("  [2] Q8_0 quantize/dequant round-trip ... ");
    const int n = 64;
    std::vector<float> hx(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) hx[i] = (float)(i - 32) * 0.1f;
    float *dx, *dout;
    uint8_t *dq;
    int n_blocks = (n + 31) / 32;
    int q_bytes = n_blocks * 34;
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&dx, n*4)); CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&dq, q_bytes));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&dout, n*4));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(dx, hx.data(), n*4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    ix_quantize_q8_0(dx, dq, n, 0);
    ix_dequant_q8_0(dq, dout, n, 0);
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
    std::vector<float> ho(n);
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(ho.data(), dout, n*4, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
    float max_err = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        float err = fabsf(ho[i] - hx[i]);
        if (err > max_err) max_err = err;
    }
    // Q8_0 with 127 levels should have max error < 0.03 for this range
    if (max_err > 0.05f) { printf("FAIL: max_err=%.4f\n", max_err); g_fail++; }
    else { printf("PASS (max_err=%.4f)\n", max_err); g_pass++; }
    cudaFree(dx); cudaFree(dq); cudaFree(dout);
}

static void test_fused_gdn() {
    printf("  [3] Fused GDN step+norm ... ");
    const int nh = 2, S = 4;
    std::vector<float> state(nh*S*S, 0.0f);
    std::vector<float> q(nh*S, 1.0f), k(nh*S, 1.0f), v(nh*S, 1.0f);
    std::vector<float> gate(nh, 0.5f), beta(nh, 1.0f), z(nh*S, 0.0f);
    std::vector<float> gamma(nh*S, 1.0f);
    float *ds,*dq,*dk,*dv,*dg,*db,*dz,*dgm,*dr;
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&ds, nh*S*S*4)); CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&dq, nh*S*4));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&dk, nh*S*4)); CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&dv, nh*S*4));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&dg, nh*4)); CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&db, nh*4));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&dz, nh*S*4)); CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&dgm, nh*S*4));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMalloc(&dr, nh*S*4));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(ds, state.data(), nh*S*S*4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(dq, q.data(), nh*S*4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(dk, k.data(), nh*S*4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(dv, v.data(), nh*S*4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(dg, gate.data(), nh*4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(db, beta.data(), nh*4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(dz, z.data(), nh*S*4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(dgm, gamma.data(), nh*S*4, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));
    ix_fused_gdn_step_norm(ds,dq,dk,dv,dg,db,dz,dgm,1e-5f,dr,nh,S,0);
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaDeviceSynchronize());
    std::vector<float> hr(nh*S);
    CHECK_CUDA(cudaMemcpy(hr.data(), dr, nh*S*4, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));
    // With z=0, sigmoid(0)=0.5, result should be non-zero
    bool ok = false;
    for (int i = 0; i < nh*S; i++) if (hr[i] != 0.0f) ok = true;
    // With zero initial state, after one step state gets populated
    if (!ok) { printf("FAIL: all zeros\n"); g_fail++; }
    else { printf("PASS (r[0]=%.6f)\n", hr[0]); g_pass++; }
    cudaFree(ds);cudaFree(dq);cudaFree(dk);cudaFree(dv);
    cudaFree(dg);cudaFree(db);cudaFree(dz);cudaFree(dgm);cudaFree(dr);
}

int main() {
    printf("=== infccl Unit 4: CUDA Kernel Tests (BI-V100) ===\n\n");
    int dc=0; cudaGetDeviceCount(&dc);
    printf("GPUs detected: %d\n",dc);
    if(!dc){printf("No GPU.\n");return 1;}
    cudaDeviceProp p; cudaGetDeviceProperties(&p,0);
    printf("  GPU 0: %s\n\n",p.name);
    test_gr_write(); test_quantize_q8_0(); test_fused_gdn();
    printf("\n=== Results: %d passed, %d failed ===\n",g_pass,g_fail);
    return g_fail>0?1:0;
}

// ix_rope.cu -- NeoX RoPE for BI-V100 (ivcore10, warp64)
// NeoX pairing: (d, d + n_rot/2). Device positions. freq_base = 1e7.

#include "strata/kernels/cuda/ix_warp64.cuh"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cmath>

namespace strata { namespace kernels { namespace {

__global__ void ix_rope_neox_kernel(
    float* __restrict__ x, const int32_t* __restrict__ pos,
    const float* __restrict__ cos_tab, const float* __restrict__ sin_tab,
    int n_head, int head_dim, int n_rot, int max_pos) {
    const int h = (int)blockIdx.x, d = (int)blockIdx.y * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (h >= n_head || d >= n_rot / 2) return;
    const int p = pos[0];
    if (p < 0 || p >= max_pos) return;
    const int half = n_rot / 2;
    const float c = cos_tab[p * half + d], s = sin_tab[p * half + d];
    const float x0 = x[h * head_dim + d], x1 = x[h * head_dim + d + half];
    x[h * head_dim + d]        = x0 * c - x1 * s;
    x[h * head_dim + d + half] = x0 * s + x1 * c;
}

__global__ void ix_rope_neox_batch_kernel(
    float* __restrict__ x, const int32_t* __restrict__ pos,
    const float* __restrict__ cos_tab, const float* __restrict__ sin_tab,
    int T, int n_head, int head_dim, int n_rot, int max_pos) {
    const int t = (int)blockIdx.z, h = (int)blockIdx.x, d = (int)blockIdx.y * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;
    if (t >= T || h >= n_head || d >= n_rot / 2) return;
    const int p = pos[t];
    if (p < 0 || p >= max_pos) return;
    const int half = n_rot / 2, base = t * n_head * head_dim + h * head_dim;
    const float c = cos_tab[p * half + d], s = sin_tab[p * half + d];
    const float x0 = x[base + d], x1 = x[base + d + half];
    x[base + d]        = x0 * c - x1 * s;
    x[base + d + half] = x0 * s + x1 * c;
}
} // anon
extern "C" {
void ix_rope_neox(float* x, const int32_t* pos, const float* cos_tab, const float* sin_tab,
                  int n_head, int head_dim, int n_rot, int max_pos, cudaStream_t stream) {
    const int half = n_rot / 2, thr = 64;
    dim3 grid(n_head, (half + thr - 1) / thr);
    ix_rope_neox_kernel<<<grid, thr, 0, stream>>>(x, pos, cos_tab, sin_tab, n_head, head_dim, n_rot, max_pos);
}
void ix_rope_neox_batch(float* x, const int32_t* pos, const float* cos_tab, const float* sin_tab,
                        int T, int n_head, int head_dim, int n_rot, int max_pos, cudaStream_t stream) {
    const int half = n_rot / 2, thr = 64;
    dim3 grid(n_head, (half + thr - 1) / thr, T);
    ix_rope_neox_batch_kernel<<<grid, thr, 0, stream>>>(x, pos, cos_tab, sin_tab, T, n_head, head_dim, n_rot, max_pos);
}
} // extern C
}} // ns
ENDOFFILE

// ix_kv_q8.cu -- INT8 KV cache append/gather for BI-V100 (ivcore10)
// Per-64-group quantize via fp16 scale round-trip. Paged storage.

#include "strata/kernels/cuda/ix_warp64.cuh"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cmath>

namespace strata { namespace kernels { namespace {
constexpr int KVG = 64;

__global__ void ix_kv_append_q8_kernel(
    int8_t* __restrict__ kq, int8_t* __restrict__ vq,
    uint16_t* __restrict__ ks, uint16_t* __restrict__ vs,
    const int32_t* __restrict__ tab, const int32_t* __restrict__ step,
    const float* __restrict__ kc, const float* __restrict__ vc,
    int kvh, int hd, int ps) {
    const int head = (int)blockIdx.x, grp = (int)blockIdx.y, tid = threadIdx.x;
    if (head >= kvh) return;
    const int gs = grp * KVG; if (gs >= hd) return;
    const int ge = (gs + KVG < hd) ? gs + KVG : hd, gsz = ge - gs;
    const int pos = step[0], page = tab[pos / ps];
    const int64_t row = (int64_t)page * kvh * ps + (int64_t)head * ps + (pos % ps);
    const int ng = (hd + KVG - 1) / KVG;
    __shared__ float sh[4];
    // K amax
    float am = 0; for (int i = tid; i < gsz; i += (int)blockDim.x) { float v = kc[head*hd+gs+i]; float a = v<0?-v:v; if(a>am) am=a; }
    for (int o=IX_WARP_SIZE/2;o>0;o>>=1){float t=ix_shfl_xor(am,o);if(t>am)am=t;}
    int wid=tid/IX_WARP_SIZE,lane=tid%IX_WARP_SIZE;
    if(lane==0)sh[wid]=am; __syncthreads();
    if(tid==0){float m=sh[0];for(int w=1;w<2;w++)if(sh[w]>m)m=sh[w];sh[0]=m;} __syncthreads();
    am=sh[0]; float sc=am/127.0f; uint16_t s16=ix_f32_to_f16_bits(sc);
    float sst=ix_f16_to_f32_bits(s16); float inv=(sst>0)?1.0f/sst:0.0f;
    for(int i=tid;i<gsz;i+=(int)blockDim.x){float v=kc[head*hd+gs+i];int q=(int)roundf(v*inv);q=q<-127?-127:(q>127?127:q);kq[row*hd+gs+i]=(int8_t)q;}
    if(tid==0) ks[row*ng+grp]=s16;
    // V amax
    am=0; for(int i=tid;i<gsz;i+=(int)blockDim.x){float v=vc[head*hd+gs+i];float a=v<0?-v:v;if(a>am)am=a;}
    for(int o=IX_WARP_SIZE/2;o>0;o>>=1){float t=ix_shfl_xor(am,o);if(t>am)am=t;}
    if(lane==0)sh[wid]=am; __syncthreads();
    if(tid==0){float m=sh[0];for(int w=1;w<2;w++)if(sh[w]>m)m=sh[w];sh[0]=m;} __syncthreads();
    am=sh[0]; sc=am/127.0f; s16=ix_f32_to_f16_bits(sc);
    sst=ix_f16_to_f32_bits(s16); inv=(sst>0)?1.0f/sst:0.0f;
    for(int i=tid;i<gsz;i+=(int)blockDim.x){float v=vc[head*hd+gs+i];int q=(int)roundf(v*inv);q=q<-127?-127:(q>127?127:q);vq[row*hd+gs+i]=(int8_t)q;}
    if(tid==0) vs[row*ng+grp]=s16;
}

__global__ void ix_kv_gather_q8_kernel(
    const int8_t* __restrict__ kq, const int8_t* __restrict__ vq,
    const uint16_t* __restrict__ ks, const uint16_t* __restrict__ vs,
    const int32_t* __restrict__ tab, const int32_t* __restrict__ ids,
    int kvh, int hd, int ps, int ns,
    uint16_t* __restrict__ ko, uint16_t* __restrict__ vo) {
    const int sel=(int)blockIdx.z, head=(int)blockIdx.x;
    const int bd=(int)blockIdx.y*blockDim.x*4+threadIdx.x*4;
    if(sel>=ns||head>=kvh||bd>=hd) return;
    const int pos=ids[sel], page=tab[pos/ps];
    const int64_t row=(int64_t)page*kvh*ps+(int64_t)head*ps+(pos%ps);
    const int ng=(hd+KVG-1)/KVG, grp=bd/KVG;
    float ksc=ix_f16_to_f32_bits(ks[row*ng+grp]), vsc=ix_f16_to_f32_bits(vs[row*ng+grp]);
    const int64_t db=row*hd+bd, ob=((int64_t)sel*kvh+head)*hd+bd;
    int cnt=hd-bd; if(cnt>4) cnt=4;
    for(int i=0;i<cnt;i++){ko[ob+i]=ix_f32_to_f16_bits((float)kq[db+i]*ksc);vo[ob+i]=ix_f32_to_f16_bits((float)vq[db+i]*vsc);}
}
} // anon
extern "C" {
void ix_kv_append_q8(int8_t* kq, int8_t* vq, uint16_t* ks, uint16_t* vs,
    const int32_t* tab, const int32_t* step, const float* kc, const float* vc,
    int kvh, int hd, int ps, cudaStream_t stream) {
    dim3 grid(kvh, (hd+KVG-1)/KVG);
    ix_kv_append_q8_kernel<<<grid, 128, 0, stream>>>(kq,vq,ks,vs,tab,step,kc,vc,kvh,hd,ps);
}
void ix_kv_gather_q8(const int8_t* kq, const int8_t* vq, const uint16_t* ks, const uint16_t* vs,
    const int32_t* tab, const int32_t* ids, int kvh, int hd, int ps, int ns,
    uint16_t* ko, uint16_t* vo, cudaStream_t stream) {
    dim3 grid(kvh, (hd+64*4-1)/(64*4), ns);
    ix_kv_gather_q8_kernel<<<grid, 64, 0, stream>>>(kq,vq,ks,vs,tab,ids,kvh,hd,ps,ns,ko,vo);
}
} // extern C
}} // ns
ENDOFFILE

// ix_router_top10.cu -- MoE router: softmax + stable top-k + renormalize (BI-V100)
// Stable argsort by rank. 512 experts, single block. Renorm 2^-14 floor.

#include "strata/kernels/cuda/ix_warp64.cuh"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cmath>

namespace strata { namespace kernels { namespace {
constexpr int MX = 512;

__global__ void ix_router_top10_kernel(
    const float* __restrict__ logits, int ne, int k,
    int32_t* __restrict__ ids, float* __restrict__ wts) {
    __shared__ float sp[MX]; __shared__ float swm[8];
    const int tid = threadIdx.x;
    float l = (tid < ne) ? logits[tid] : -1e30f;
    float wm = l;
    for(int o=IX_WARP_SIZE/2;o>0;o>>=1){float t=ix_shfl_xor(wm,o);if(t>wm)wm=t;}
    int wid=tid/IX_WARP_SIZE, lane=tid%IX_WARP_SIZE;
    if(lane==0) swm[wid]=wm; __syncthreads();
    if(tid==0){float m=swm[0];for(int w=1;w<8;w++)if(swm[w]>m)m=swm[w];swm[0]=m;} __syncthreads();
    float gm=swm[0];
    float e=(tid<ne)?expf(l-gm):0.0f; sp[tid]=e; __syncthreads();
    __shared__ float ss;
    if(tid==0){float s=0;for(int i=0;i<ne;i++)s+=sp[i];ss=s;} __syncthreads();
    float inv=1.0f/ss;
    if(tid<ne) sp[tid]*=inv; __syncthreads();
    if(tid<ne){float my=sp[tid];int rank=0;
        for(int f=0;f<ne;f++){float pf=sp[f];if(pf>my||(pf==my&&f<tid))rank++;}
        if(rank<k){ids[rank]=tid;wts[rank]=my;}}
    __syncthreads();
    if(tid==0){float ws=0;for(int i=0;i<k;i++)ws+=wts[i];
        float d=ws;if(d<6.103515625e-05f)d=6.103515625e-05f;float ri=1.0f/d;
        for(int i=0;i<k;i++)wts[i]*=ri;}
}
} // anon
extern "C" {
void ix_router_top10(const float* logits, int ne, int k, int32_t* ids, float* wts, cudaStream_t stream) {
    ix_router_top10_kernel<<<1, MX, 0, stream>>>(logits, ne, k, ids, wts);
}
} // extern C
}} // ns
ENDOFFILE

cat > src/strata/kernels/cuda/ix_qsa_select.cu << 'ENDOFFILE'
// ix_qsa_select.cu -- QSA block scoring + top-k for BI-V100 (ivcore10)

#include "strata/kernels/cuda/ix_warp64.cuh"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cmath>

namespace strata { namespace kernels { namespace {
constexpr int QR = 4;

__global__ void ix_block_scores_kernel(
    const float* __restrict__ kp, const float* __restrict__ q, const int32_t* __restrict__ step,
    int nkv, int nh, int nkvh, int hd, int mb, float* __restrict__ sc) {
    const int b=(int)blockIdx.x; if(b>=mb) return;
    const int tid=threadIdx.x, gqa=nh/nkvh;
    int rp=(b+1)*QR-1; if(rp>=nkv) rp=nkv-1;
    float bs=0;
    for(int h=0;h<nh;h++){int kvh=h/gqa;
        float dot=0; for(int d=tid;d<hd;d+=(int)blockDim.x) dot+=kp[((int64_t)rp*nkvh+kvh)*hd+d]*q[(int64_t)h*hd+d];
        for(int o=IX_WARP_SIZE/2;o>0;o>>=1) dot+=ix_shfl_xor(dot,o);
        __shared__ float sd[8]; int wid=tid/IX_WARP_SIZE,lane=tid%IX_WARP_SIZE;
        if(lane==0)sd[wid]=dot; __syncthreads();
        if(tid==0){float s=0;int nw=((int)blockDim.x+IX_WARP_SIZE-1)/IX_WARP_SIZE;for(int w=0;w<nw;w++)s+=sd[w];if(s>0)bs+=s;}
        __syncthreads();}
    if(tid==0) sc[b]=bs;
}

__global__ void ix_block_topk_kernel(const float* __restrict__ sc, int mb, int cap, int32_t* __restrict__ ids) {
    if(threadIdx.x!=0) return;
    float ts[128]; int32_t ti[128];
    for(int i=0;i<cap;i++){ts[i]=-1e30f;ti[i]=-1;}
    for(int b=0;b<mb;b++){float s=sc[b];
        if(s>ts[cap-1]){int p=cap-1;while(p>0&&s>ts[p-1]){ts[p]=ts[p-1];ti[p]=ti[p-1];p--;}ts[p]=s;ti[p]=b;}}
    for(int i=0;i<cap;i++) ids[i]=ti[i];
}
} // anon
extern "C" {
void ix_block_scores(const float* kp, const float* q, const int32_t* step,
    int nkv, int nh, int nkvh, int hd, int mb, float* sc, cudaStream_t stream) {
    ix_block_scores_kernel<<<mb, 256, 0, stream>>>(kp,q,step,nkv,nh,nkvh,hd,mb,sc);
}
void ix_block_topk(const float* sc, int mb, int cap, int32_t* ids, cudaStream_t stream) {
    ix_block_topk_kernel<<<1, 1, 0, stream>>>(sc, mb, cap, ids);
}
} // extern C
}} // ns
ENDOFFILE

cat > src/strata/kernels/cuda/ix_sampler.cu << 'ENDOFFILE'
// ix_sampler.cu -- Sampler chain for BI-V100 (ivcore10, warp64)
// penalties -> temp -> softmax -> top-k -> top-p -> Philox 4x32-10 pick.

#include "strata/kernels/cuda/ix_warp64.cuh"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cmath>

namespace strata { namespace kernels { namespace {

struct Philox4x32 {
    uint32_t c[4], k[2];
    __device__ void init(uint64_t s, uint64_t q){c[0]=(uint32_t)q;c[1]=(uint32_t)(q>>32);c[2]=0;c[3]=0;k[0]=(uint32_t)s;k[1]=(uint32_t)(s>>32);}
    __device__ void rp(uint32_t& L, uint32_t& R, uint32_t K){uint64_t p=(uint64_t)0xD2511F53u*(uint64_t)L;L=(uint32_t)(p>>32)^R^K;R=(uint32_t)p;}
    __device__ float uniform(){uint32_t k0=k[0],k1=k[1];for(int r=0;r<10;r++){rp(c[0],c[1],k0);rp(c[2],c[3],k1);k0+=0x9E3779B9u;k1+=0xBB67AE85u;}return(float)(c[0]>>8)*(1.0f/16777216.0f);}
};

__global__ void ix_greedy_argmax_kernel(const float* __restrict__ lg, int nv, int32_t* __restrict__ out) {
    __shared__ float sm[8]; __shared__ int si[8];
    const int tid=threadIdx.x; float mx=-1e30f; int mi=0;
    for(int i=tid;i<nv;i+=(int)blockDim.x){float v=lg[i];if(v>mx){mx=v;mi=i;}}
    for(int o=IX_WARP_SIZE/2;o>0;o>>=1){float om=ix_shfl_xor(mx,o);int oi=(int)__float_as_uint(ix_shfl_xor(__uint_as_float((unsigned)mi),o));if(om>mx||(om==mx&&oi<mi)){mx=om;mi=oi;}}
    int wid=tid/IX_WARP_SIZE,lane=tid%IX_WARP_SIZE;
    if(lane==0){sm[wid]=mx;si[wid]=mi;} __syncthreads();
    if(tid==0){float b=sm[0];int bi=si[0];int nw=((int)blockDim.x+IX_WARP_SIZE-1)/IX_WARP_SIZE;
        for(int w=1;w<nw;w++)if(sm[w]>b||(sm[w]==b&&si[w]<bi)){b=sm[w];bi=si[w];}out[0]=bi;}
}

__global__ void ix_sampler_kernel(float* __restrict__ lg, int nv,
    float temp, float tp, int tk, float pr, float pf, float pp,
    const int32_t* __restrict__ hist, int hl, uint64_t seed, int32_t* __restrict__ out) {
    if(threadIdx.x!=0) return;
    for(int h=0;h<hl;h++){int t=hist[h];if(t<0||t>=nv)continue;float l=lg[t];
        if(l<=0)l*=pr;else l/=pr;int cnt=0;for(int j=0;j<=h;j++)if(hist[j]==t)cnt++;
        l-=(float)cnt*pf;if(cnt>0)l-=pp;lg[t]=l;}
    if(temp>0&&temp!=1.0f){float it=1.0f/temp;for(int i=0;i<nv;i++)lg[i]*=it;}
    float mx=lg[0];for(int i=1;i<nv;i++)if(lg[i]>mx)mx=lg[i];
    float se=0;for(int i=0;i<nv;i++){float e=expf(lg[i]-mx);lg[i]=e;se+=e;}
    float is=1.0f/se;for(int i=0;i<nv;i++)lg[i]*=is;
    if(tk>0&&tk<nv){float prev=2,kth=-1;for(int p=0;p<tk;p++){float best=-1;
        for(int i=0;i<nv;i++){float v=lg[i];if(v<prev&&v>best)best=v;}
        if(best<0)break;kth=best;prev=best;}
        if(kth>=0)for(int i=0;i<nv;i++)if(lg[i]<kth)lg[i]=0;}
    if(tp>0&&tp<1.0f){float cum=0,thr=-1,prev=2;
        while(cum<tp){float best=-1;for(int i=0;i<nv;i++){float v=lg[i];if(v>0&&v<=prev&&v>best)best=v;}
            if(best<=0)break;for(int i=0;i<nv;i++)if(lg[i]==best){cum+=best;if(cum>=tp){thr=best;break;}}
            if(cum>=tp)break;prev=best;}
        if(thr>0)for(int i=0;i<nv;i++)if(lg[i]<thr)lg[i]=0;}
    float rs=0;for(int i=0;i<nv;i++)rs+=lg[i];
    if(rs>0){float ri=1.0f/rs;for(int i=0;i<nv;i++)lg[i]*=ri;}
    Philox4x32 rng;rng.init(seed,0);float u=rng.uniform();
    float cum=0;int pick=nv-1;for(int i=0;i<nv;i++){cum+=lg[i];if(cum>=u){pick=i;break;}}
    out[0]=pick;
}
} // anon
extern "C" {
void ix_greedy_argmax(const float* lg, int nv, int32_t* out, cudaStream_t stream){ix_greedy_argmax_kernel<<<1,512,0,stream>>>(lg,nv,out);}
void ix_sampler(float* lg, int nv, float temp, float tp, int tk, float pr, float pf, float pp,
    const int32_t* hist, int hl, uint64_t seed, int32_t* out, cudaStream_t stream){
    ix_sampler_kernel<<<1,1,0,stream>>>(lg,nv,temp,tp,tk,pr,pf,pp,hist,hl,seed,out);}
} // extern C
}} // ns
ENDOFFILE

Wait — that breaks the argmax logic (we lose index tracking). Let me do it properly — the greedy argmax should use the shared memory approach that the existing code already has for the cross-warp part:

$ cat > /home/claude/baloon/src/strata/kernels/cuda/ix_sampler.cu << 'ENDOFFILE'
// ix_sampler.cu -- Sampler chain for BI-V100 (ivcore10, warp64)

#include "strata/kernels/cuda/ix_warp64.cuh"
#include <cuda_runtime.h>
#include <cuda_fp16.h>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cmath>

namespace strata { namespace kernels { namespace {

struct Philox4x32 {
    uint32_t c[4], k[2];
    __device__ void init(uint64_t s, uint64_t q){c[0]=(uint32_t)q;c[1]=(uint32_t)(q>>32);c[2]=0;c[3]=0;k[0]=(uint32_t)s;k[1]=(uint32_t)(s>>32);}
    __device__ void rp(uint32_t& L, uint32_t& R, uint32_t K){uint64_t p=(uint64_t)0xD2511F53u*(uint64_t)L;L=(uint32_t)(p>>32)^R^K;R=(uint32_t)p;}
    __device__ float uniform(){uint32_t k0=k[0],k1=k[1];for(int r=0;r<10;r++){rp(c[0],c[1],k0);rp(c[2],c[3],k1);k0+=0x9E3779B9u;k1+=0xBB67AE85u;}return(float)(c[0]>>8)*(1.0f/16777216.0f);}
};

// Greedy argmax: parallel reduction via shared memory (no __float_as_uint)
__global__ void ix_greedy_argmax_kernel(const float* __restrict__ lg, int nv, int32_t* __restrict__ out) {
    __shared__ float sm[8]; __shared__ int si[8];
    const int tid = threadIdx.x;
    float mx = -1e30f; int mi = 0;
    // Each thread scans a strided range
    for (int i = tid; i < nv; i += (int)blockDim.x) {
        float v = lg[i]; if (v > mx) { mx = v; mi = i; }
    }
    // Warp-level reduce via shared memory (avoid __float_as_uint)
    int wid = tid / IX_WARP_SIZE, lane = tid % IX_WARP_SIZE;
    // Intra-warp: use shared memory pairs
    __shared__ float sw_val[512];
    __shared__ int sw_idx[512];
    sw_val[tid] = mx; sw_idx[tid] = mi;
    __syncthreads();
    // Tree reduction in shared memory
    for (int s = (int)blockDim.x / 2; s > 0; s >>= 1) {
        if (tid < s) {
            if (sw_val[tid + s] > sw_val[tid] ||
                (sw_val[tid + s] == sw_val[tid] && sw_idx[tid + s] < sw_idx[tid])) {
                sw_val[tid] = sw_val[tid + s];
                sw_idx[tid] = sw_idx[tid + s];
            }
        }
        __syncthreads();
    }
    if (tid == 0) out[0] = sw_idx[0];
}

__global__ void ix_sampler_kernel(float* __restrict__ lg, int nv,
    float temp, float tp, int tk, float pr, float pf, float pp,
    const int32_t* __restrict__ hist, int hl, uint64_t seed, int32_t* __restrict__ out) {
    if (threadIdx.x != 0) return;
    // 1. penalties
    for (int h = 0; h < hl; h++) {
        int t = hist[h]; if (t < 0 || t >= nv) continue;
        float l = lg[t];
        if (l <= 0) l *= pr; else l /= pr;
        int cnt = 0; for (int j = 0; j <= h; j++) if (hist[j] == t) cnt++;
        l -= (float)cnt * pf; if (cnt > 0) l -= pp; lg[t] = l;
    }
    // 2. temperature
    if (temp > 0 && temp != 1.0f) { float it = 1.0f / temp; for (int i = 0; i < nv; i++) lg[i] *= it; }
    // 3. softmax
    float mx = lg[0]; for (int i = 1; i < nv; i++) if (lg[i] > mx) mx = lg[i];
    float se = 0; for (int i = 0; i < nv; i++) { float e = expf(lg[i] - mx); lg[i] = e; se += e; }
    float is = 1.0f / se; for (int i = 0; i < nv; i++) lg[i] *= is;
    // 4. top-k
    if (tk > 0 && tk < nv) {
        float prev = 2.0f, kth = -1.0f;
        for (int pass = 0; pass < tk; pass++) {
            float best = -1.0f;
            for (int i = 0; i < nv; i++) { float v = lg[i]; if (v < prev && v > best) best = v; }
            if (best < 0) break; kth = best; prev = best;
        }
        if (kth >= 0) for (int i = 0; i < nv; i++) if (lg[i] < kth) lg[i] = 0;
    }
    // 5. top-p
    if (tp > 0 && tp < 1.0f) {
        float cum = 0, thr = -1.0f, prev = 2.0f;
        while (cum < tp) {
            float best = -1.0f;
            for (int i = 0; i < nv; i++) { float v = lg[i]; if (v > 0 && v <= prev && v > best) best = v; }
            if (best <= 0) break;
            for (int i = 0; i < nv; i++) if (lg[i] == best) { cum += best; if (cum >= tp) { thr = best; break; } }
            if (cum >= tp) break; prev = best;
        }
        if (thr > 0) for (int i = 0; i < nv; i++) if (lg[i] < thr) lg[i] = 0;
    }
    // 6. renormalize
    float rs = 0; for (int i = 0; i < nv; i++) rs += lg[i];
    if (rs > 0) { float ri = 1.0f / rs; for (int i = 0; i < nv; i++) lg[i] *= ri; }
    // 7. Philox pick
    Philox4x32 rng; rng.init(seed, 0); float u = rng.uniform();
    float cum = 0; int pick = nv - 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < nv; i++) { cum += lg[i]; if (cum >= u) { pick = i; break; } }
    out[0] = pick;
}
} // anon

extern "C" {
void ix_greedy_argmax(const float* lg, int nv, int32_t* out, cudaStream_t stream) {
    ix_greedy_argmax_kernel<<<1, 512, 0, stream>>>(lg, nv, out);
}
void ix_sampler(float* lg, int nv, float temp, float tp, int tk, float pr, float pf, float pp,
    const int32_t* hist, int hl, uint64_t seed, int32_t* out, cudaStream_t stream) {
    ix_sampler_kernel<<<1, 1, 0, stream>>>(lg, nv, temp, tp, tk, pr, pf, pp, hist, hl, seed, out);
}
} // extern C
}} // ns
ENDOFFILE

$ cd /home/claude/baloon && for f in \
  src/strata/kernels/cuda/ix_fused_gdn.cu \
  src/strata/kernels/cuda/ix_fused_gr.cu \

  src/strata/kernels/cuda/ix_qsa_decode_attn.cu \
  src/strata/kernels/cuda/ix_iq_kernels.cu \

  src/strata/kernels/cuda/ix_qsa_select.cu \
  src/strata/kernels/cuda/ix_sampler.cu; do
  # Replace em dash with --
  sed -i 's/—/--/g' "$f"
  # Replace box drawing horizontal with -

done
